# BH00013 (Unnamed)

*Translated on 17 Qudrat 183 using GPT 6.1 Sol*

### 1

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسم ربّنا الأقدس الأعظم العلیّ الأبهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bismi Rabbinā al-Aqdas al-Aʿẓam al-ʿAlī al-Abhā.
:::

::: {.translation}
In the name of our Lord, the Most Holy, the Most Great, the Most Exalted, the All-Glorious.
:::

### 2

::: {.original lang="ar"}
البهآء لمن خرق الأحجاب فی یوم المآب و کسّر اصنام الأوهام باسم مالک الأیّام و قام علی خدمة الأمر علی شأن ما خوّفته سطوة جبابرة الأرض الّذین زیّنوا رؤوسهم بالعمائم و اخذوا زمام العباد باسم ربّهم مالک الایجاد کانوا ان یدخلوا المساجد و المعابد لذکر اللّه و تلاوة ما انزله علی حبیبه و صفیّه فلمّا انار افق العالم و اشرقت منه شمس اسمه الأعظم الّذی به ثبت امر کلّ نبیّ و تحقّق رسالة کلّ رسول اعرضوا عنه و انکروه و نبذوا امره و نقضوا عهده و ارتکبوا ما ناحت به الذّرّات و انصعقت الحوریّات فی الغرفات
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Al-bahāʾ li-man kharaqa al-aḥjāb fī yawm al-maʾāb wa-kassara aṣnām al-awhām bi-ismi Mālik al-ayyām wa-qāma ʿalā khidmat al-amr ʿalā shaʾn mā khawwafat-hu saṭwat jabābirat al-arḍ alladhīna zayyanū ruʾūsahum bi-al-ʿamāʾim wa-akhadhū zimām al-ʿibād bi-ismi Rabbihim Mālik al-ījād. Kānū an yadkhulū al-masājid wa-al-maʿābid li-dhikr Allāh wa-tilāwat mā anzalahu ʿalā Ḥabībihi wa-Ṣafiyyihi. Fa-lammā anāra ufuq al-ʿālam wa-ashraqat minhu shams ismihi al-Aʿẓam alladhī bihi thabata amr kull nabī wa-taḥaqqaqa risālat kull rasūl aʿraḍū ʿanhu wa-ankarūhu wa-nabadhū amrahu wa-naqaḍū ʿahdahu wa-irtakabū mā nāḥat bihi al-dharrāt wa-inṣaʿaqat al-ḥūriyyāt fī al-ghurafāt.
:::

::: {.translation}
Glory be upon whoever has torn through the veils on the Day of Return, shattered the idols of vain imaginings in the name of the Lord of Days, and arisen to serve the Cause in such a way that the might of the tyrants of the earth has not frightened him—those who have adorned their heads with turbans and seized the reins of the people in the name of their Lord, the Lord of creation. They used to enter mosques and places of worship to remember God and recite what He had sent down to His Beloved and Chosen One. Yet when the horizon of the world was illumined and the Sun of His Most Great Name rose above it—the Name through which the cause of every prophet was established and the mission of every messenger fulfilled—they turned away from Him, denied Him, cast aside His Cause, broke His covenant, and committed deeds that made the atoms lament and the heavenly maidens swoon in their chambers.
:::

### 3

::: {.original lang="ar"}
لعمر اللّه باعمالهم ذرفت عیون اهل الفردوس الأعلی و الجنّة العلیا باسمه افتخروا بین النّاس و وردوا علیه بعد ظهوره ما عجز عن ذکره ملکوت البیان قد انکروا یوم اللّه الّذی تزیّن بذکره الکتب و الزّبر و الصّحف و الألواح یشهد الخادم و کلّ الأشیآء بغفلتهم و جهلهم و ضلالتهم اولئک الّذین حقّت علیهم کلمة العذاب فی الکتاب یکفیهم ما انزله اللّه فی الفرقان قوله تعالی و جعلنا لهم سمعاً و ابصاراً و افئدةً فما اغنی عنهم سمعهم و لا ابصارهم و لا افئدتهم من شیء اذ کانوا یجحدون بآیات اللّه و حاق بهم ما کانوا به یستهزئون قد اخذوا کتاب انفسهم و نبذوا امّ الکتاب عن ورائهم لعمر اللّه هم الأصنام و مطالع الظّنون و مشارق الأوهام و هم جبابرة الأرض و فراعنها قد تمسّکوا بالنّفس و الهوی معرضین عن مولی الوری متّکئین علی اقلامهم معرضین علی ما نزل من القلم الأعلی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
La-ʿamr Allāh, bi-aʿmālihim dharafat ʿuyūn ahl al-Firdaws al-Aʿlā wa-al-jannat al-ʿulyā. Bi-ismihi iftakharū bayna al-nās wa-waradū ʿalayhi baʿda ẓuhūrihi mā ʿajaza ʿan dhikrihi malakūt al-bayān. Qad ankarū yawm Allāh alladhī tazayyana bi-dhikrihi al-kutub wa-al-zubur wa-al-ṣuḥuf wa-al-alwāḥ. Yashhadu al-khādim wa-kull al-ashyāʾ bi-ghaflatihim wa-jahlihim wa-ḍalālatihim. Ulāʾika alladhīna ḥaqqat ʿalayhim kalimat al-ʿadhāb fī al-kitāb. Yakfīhim mā anzalahu Allāh fī al-Furqān, qawluhu taʿālā: Wa-jaʿalnā lahum samʿan wa-abṣāran wa-afʾidatan fa-mā aghnā ʿanhum samʿuhum wa-lā abṣāruhum wa-lā afʾidatuhum min shayʾ idh kānū yajḥadūna bi-āyāt Allāh wa-ḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziʾūn. Qad akhadhū kitāb anfusihim wa-nabadhū Umm al-Kitāb ʿan warāʾihim. La-ʿamr Allāh, hum al-aṣnām wa-maṭāliʿ al-ẓunūn wa-mashāriq al-awhām wa-hum jabābirat al-arḍ wa-farāʿinatuhā. Qad tamassakū bi-al-nafs wa-al-hawā muʿriḍīna ʿan Mawlā al-warā muttakiʾīna ʿalā aqlāmihim muʿriḍīna ʿalā mā nazala min al-Qalam al-Aʿlā.
:::

::: {.translation}
By the life of God! Their deeds have brought tears to the eyes of the inhabitants of the most exalted Paradise and the highest Garden. In His name they vaunted themselves among the people, yet after His appearance they inflicted on Him what the kingdom of utterance is powerless to describe. They have denied the Day of God, whose mention adorns the books, scriptures, scrolls, and tablets. This servant and all things bear witness to their heedlessness, ignorance, and error. These are the ones against whom the sentence of punishment pronounced in the Book has become binding. What God sent down in the Qur’an suffices them. Exalted is His utterance: “We gave them hearing, sight, and hearts, but neither their hearing, nor their sight, nor their hearts availed them in the least, since they denied the signs of God; and what they used to ridicule engulfed them.” They have taken up the book of their own selves and cast the Mother Book behind their backs. By the life of God! They are the idols, the sources of conjecture and the dawning places of vain imaginings; they are the tyrants of the earth and its pharaohs. They have clung to self and desire, turning away from the Lord of humanity, relying on their own pens and turning away from what has descended from the Most Exalted Pen.
:::

### 4

::: {.original lang="ar"}
سبحانک یا من بآیاتک اهتزّ من فی القبور و بنفحات قمیصک طار الطّور عند اشراق النّور من افق الظّهور اسئلک بسراج امرک و امواج بحر بیانک بأن تؤیّد اولیائک علی ذکرک و ثنائک و علی القیام علی خدمتک ثمّ احفظهم یا الهی بقدرتک و قوّتک عن الّذین انکروا حقّک و جاحدوا برهانک و جادلوا بآیاتک ثمّ اجعلهم یا الهی اعلام نصرک فی بلادک و رایات عزّ ک فی دیارک ثمّ اسئلک یا محبوب العالم و الظّاهر بالاسم الأعظم بأن توفّق من اقبل الی افقک الأعلی و قام علی خدمة امرک بین الوری ای ربّ تراه ناصراً لدینک و قائماً علی صراطک و ناطقاً باسمک بین عبادک ایّده بتأیید لا توقّفه شئونات العالم و لا زماجیر الأمم انت الّذی فی قبضتک زمام القوّة و الاقتدار و یطوف حول مشیّتک مظاهر العظمة و الاختیار لا اله الّا انت المقتدر المتعالی العزیز البصّار
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Subḥānaka yā man bi-āyātika ihtazza man fī al-qubūr wa-bi-nafaḥāt qamīṣika ṭāra al-Ṭūr ʿinda ishrāq al-nūr min ufuq al-ẓuhūr. Asʾaluka bi-sirāj amrika wa-amwāj baḥr bayānika bi-an tuʾayyida awliyāʾaka ʿalā dhikrika wa-thanāʾika wa-ʿalā al-qiyām ʿalā khidmatika. Thumma iḥfaẓhum yā Ilāhī bi-qudratika wa-quwwatika ʿan alladhīna ankarū ḥaqqaka wa-jāḥadū burhānaka wa-jādalū bi-āyātika. Thumma ijʿalhum yā Ilāhī aʿlām naṣrika fī bilādika wa-rāyāt ʿizzika fī diyārika. Thumma asʾaluka yā Maḥbūb al-ʿālam wa-al-Ẓāhir bi-al-Ism al-Aʿẓam bi-an tuwaffiqa man aqbala ilā ufuqika al-aʿlā wa-qāma ʿalā khidmat amrika bayna al-warā. Ay Rabb, tarāhu nāṣiran li-dīnika wa-qāʾiman ʿalā ṣirāṭika wa-nāṭiqan bi-ismika bayna ʿibādika. Ayyidhu bi-taʾyīd lā tūqifuhu shuʾūnāt al-ʿālam wa-lā zamājīr al-umam. Anta alladhī fī qabḍatika zimām al-quwwa wa-al-iqtidār wa-yaṭūfu ḥawla mashīʾatika maẓāhir al-ʿaẓama wa-al-ikhtiyār. Lā ilāha illā Anta al-Muqtadir al-Mutaʿālī al-ʿAzīz al-Baṣṣār.
:::

::: {.translation}
Glory be to You, through whose verses those in the graves have stirred, and through the fragrances of whose shirt the Mount took flight when the light shone from the horizon of revelation. I ask You, by the lamp of Your Cause and the waves of the ocean of Your utterance, to strengthen Your loved ones in remembering and praising You and in arising to serve You. Then protect them, my God, by Your power and might, from those who have denied Your truth, rejected Your proof, and disputed Your verses. Make them, my God, the standards of Your victory in Your lands and the banners of Your glory in Your dominions. I further ask You, Beloved of the world, who are manifest through the Most Great Name, to grant success to him who has turned toward Your most exalted horizon and arisen to serve Your Cause among humanity. Lord, You see him championing Your religion, standing firm on Your path, and speaking Your name among Your servants. Strengthen him with a strength that neither the affairs of the world nor the clamors of the nations can arrest. You are the One who holds in His grasp the reins of strength and power, and around whose will revolve the manifestations of majesty and sovereignty. There is no God but You, the All-Powerful, the Most Exalted, the Almighty, the All-Seeing.
:::

### 5

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و بعد یا حبیب قلبی و محبوب فؤادی قد خبرنی صفیر طیر بیانکم و اجتذبنی تغرّد عندلیب ثنائکم و اخذنی سکر رحیق ذکرکم علی شأن اردت ان اطیر بأجنحة الاشتیاق الی مقام قدّسه اللّه عن ذکر من فی الآفاق فلمّا حضرت و فزت بأنوار شمس العزّ عرضت ما فی کتابکم عند من نزّل امّ الکتاب بحرکة من قلمه الأعلی فی ملکوت الانشآء و بعدما فاز ما فیه باصغآء مولی الوری اذاً نطق لسان الکبریآء قوله جلّ کبریائه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-baʿd, yā ḥabīb qalbī wa-maḥbūb fuʾādī, qad khabbaranī ṣafīr ṭayr bayānikum wa-ijtadhabanī tagharrud ʿandalīb thanāʾikum wa-akhadhanī sukr raḥīq dhikrikum ʿalā shaʾn aradtu an aṭīra bi-ajniḥat al-ishtiyāq ilā maqām qaddasahu Allāh ʿan dhikr man fī al-āfāq. Fa-lammā ḥaḍartu wa-fuztu bi-anwār shams al-ʿizz ʿaraḍtu mā fī kitābikum ʿinda man nazzala Umm al-Kitāb bi-ḥaraka min qalamihi al-aʿlā fī malakūt al-inshāʾ. Wa-baʿdamā fāza mā fīhi bi-iṣghāʾ Mawlā al-warā idhan naṭaqa Lisān al-Kibriyāʾ, qawluhu jalla kibriyāʾuhu:
:::

::: {.translation}
To continue, beloved of my heart and darling of my soul: the call of the bird of your utterance has brought me tidings, the song of the nightingale of your praise has drawn me, and the intoxication of the choice wine of your remembrance has so seized me that I wished to fly on wings of longing to a station God has sanctified beyond the mention of all who dwell in the world. When I entered the presence and attained the radiance of the Sun of Glory, I presented the contents of your letter before Him who sent down the Mother Book through a movement of His Most Exalted Pen in the kingdom of creation. After its contents had received the attention of the Lord of humanity, the Tongue of Grandeur spoke these words—glorified be His grandeur:
:::

### 6

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا ورقآء یا ایّها النّاظر الی الأفق الأعلی قل
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Warqāʾ, yā ayyuhā al-nāẓir ilā al-ufuq al-aʿlā, qul:
:::

::: {.translation}
“Varqá, you who gaze toward the most exalted horizon, say:
:::

### 7

::: {.original lang="ar"}
لک الحمد یا الهی و المقدّس عن ذکری و بیانی و عمّا تفوّه به خلقک فی مملکتک و نطق به عبادک فی ارضک بما جعلتنی سائراً فی دیار المعانی الی ان بلغت قطبها المقام الّذی سمّی بالبقعة النّورآء و الأرض البیضآء و سمیّتها فی مقام آخر بالأرض المحشر و اریتنی فیها جمالک و سقیتنی رحیق بیانک و عرّفتنی ما اخذنی عنّی و انسانی ما دونک اسئلک بهذه الموهبة الکبری و العطیّة العظمی بأن تحفظ لی هذا المقام الأعلی انّک انت مولی الآخرة و الأولی یشهد هذا الفانی یا الهی ببقائک و هذا الضّعیف بقدرتک و قوّتک و هذا العاشق المسکین باشراقات انوار شمس جمالک انت الّذی یا الهی و سیّدی و سندی و منای تجلّیت بحرف من کلمتک العلیا علی طور السّینآء اذاً نطقت الأغصان و الأوراق و عن ورائها الذّرّات بما نطقت به السّدرة فی طور العرفان من لدی الرّحمن و تجلّیت بحرف اخری علی ملکوت البیان اذاً نزّلت التّوریة و الانجیل و الفرقان و بقطرة من فرات رحمتک الجاریة من قلمک الأعلی قد ظهر کوثر الحیوان فی الامکان تعالت قدرتک و عظمت سلطنتک
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Laka al-ḥamd yā Ilāhī wa-al-Muqaddas ʿan dhikrī wa-bayānī wa-ʿammā tafawwaha bihi khalquka fī mamlakatika wa-naṭaqa bihi ʿibāduka fī arḍika bi-mā jaʿaltanī sāʾiran fī diyār al-maʿānī ilā an balaghtu quṭbahā al-maqām alladhī summiya bi-al-buqʿat al-nawrāʾ wa-al-arḍ al-bayḍāʾ wa-sammaytahā fī maqām ākhar bi-al-arḍ al-maḥshar wa-araytanī fīhā jamālaka wa-saqaytanī raḥīq bayānika wa-ʿarraftanī mā akhadhanī ʿannī wa-ansānī mā dūnaka. Asʾaluka bi-hādhihi al-mawhibat al-kubrā wa-al-ʿaṭiyyat al-ʿuẓmā bi-an taḥfaẓa lī hādhā al-maqām al-aʿlā. Innaka Anta Mawlā al-ākhira wa-al-ūlā. Yashhadu hādhā al-fānī yā Ilāhī bi-baqāʾika wa-hādhā al-ḍaʿīf bi-qudratika wa-quwwatika wa-hādhā al-ʿāshiq al-miskīn bi-ishrāqāt anwār shams jamālika. Anta alladhī yā Ilāhī wa-Sayyidī wa-Sanadī wa-Munāya tajallayta bi-ḥarf min kalimatika al-ʿulyā ʿalā Ṭūr al-Sīnāʾ, idhan naṭaqat al-aghṣān wa-al-awrāq wa-ʿan warāʾihā al-dharrāt bi-mā naṭaqat bihi al-Sidra fī Ṭūr al-ʿirfān min ladā al-Raḥmān. Wa-tajallayta bi-ḥarf ukhrā ʿalā malakūt al-bayān, idhan nazzalta al-Tawrāh wa-al-Injīl wa-al-Furqān. Wa-bi-qaṭra min furāt raḥmatika al-jāriya min qalamika al-aʿlā qad ẓahara Kawthar al-ḥayawān fī al-imkān. Taʿālat qudratuka wa-ʿaẓumat salṭanatuka.
:::

::: {.translation}
Praise be to You, my God, who are sanctified beyond my remembrance and expression and beyond whatever Your creatures have spoken in Your kingdom and Your servants have uttered on Your earth, for having enabled me to journey through the realms of inner meaning until I reached their center—that station called the Luminous Spot and the White Land, which in another place You named the Land of Resurrection. There You showed me Your beauty, gave me the choice wine of Your utterance to drink, and made known to me what carried me beyond myself and caused me to forget all but You. I ask You, by this greatest favor and this supreme gift, to preserve for me this most exalted station. You are indeed the Lord of the next world and of this world. This mortal being, my God, bears witness to Your eternity; this weak one, to Your power and might; and this destitute lover, to the streaming radiance of the sun of Your beauty. You, my God, my Master, my Support, and my Desire, are the One who revealed Yourself through a letter of Your most exalted Word upon Mount Sinai. Then the branches and leaves, and beyond them the atoms, uttered what the Lote Tree uttered on the Mount of recognition from the All-Merciful. Through another letter You revealed Yourself to the kingdom of utterance, and then You sent down the Torah, the Gospel, and the Qur’an. Through a drop from the sweet stream of Your mercy flowing from Your Most Exalted Pen, the river of life appeared in the world of existence. Exalted is Your power, and great is Your sovereignty.
:::

### 8

::: {.original lang="ar"}
اسئلک یا ایّها الضّارب النّابض فی جسد العالم باصبعک الأعظم بأن تقرّبنی فی کلّ الأحوال الیک و تذکّرنی الأیّام الّتی مصصت کوثر وصالک من عرق فضلک و عطائک انت الّذی یا الهی دعوتنی الیک و ادخلتنی فی قباب عظمتک و اقمتنی تلقآء الوجه علی خدمتک و ذکرک و ثنائک ای ربّ تری و تعلم انّ فرحی فی ذکرک و اقبالی الیک و بهجتی فی فضلک و عنایتک فأنزل علیّ من سحاب رحمتک ما یجعلنی متبسّماً فی ایّامک انّک انت مالک الجود و العطآء و فی قبضتک ملکوت الأسمآء لا اله الّا انت المقتدر العلیم الحکیم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Asʾaluka yā ayyuhā al-ḍārib al-nābiḍ fī jasad al-ʿālam bi-iṣbaʿika al-aʿẓam bi-an tuqarribanī fī kull al-aḥwāl ilayka wa-tudhakkiranī al-ayyām allatī maṣaṣtu Kawthar wiṣālika min ʿirq faḍlika wa-ʿaṭāʾika. Anta alladhī yā Ilāhī daʿawtanī ilayka wa-adkhaltanī fī qibāb ʿaẓamatika wa-aqamtanī tilqāʾ al-wajh ʿalā khidmatika wa-dhikrika wa-thanāʾika. Ay Rabb, tarā wa-taʿlamu anna faraḥī fī dhikrika wa-iqbālī ilayka wa-bahjatī fī faḍlika wa-ʿināyatika. Fa-anzil ʿalayya min saḥāb raḥmatika mā yajʿalunī mutabassiman fī ayyāmika. Innaka Anta Mālik al-jūd wa-al-ʿaṭāʾ wa-fī qabḍatika malakūt al-asmāʾ. Lā ilāha illā Anta al-Muqtadir al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
I ask You, who set the pulse beating in the body of the world with Your Most Great Finger, to draw me near to You in every condition and remind me of the days when I drank the river of reunion with You from the vein of Your grace and bounty. You, my God, are the One who called me to Yourself, admitted me beneath the canopies of Your majesty, and established me before Your face to serve, remember, and praise You. Lord, You see and know that my joy lies in remembering You and turning toward You, and my delight in Your grace and loving care. Send down upon me from the clouds of Your mercy what will keep me smiling in Your days. You are indeed the Lord of generosity and bounty, and in Your grasp is the kingdom of names. There is no God but You, the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.” End.
:::

### 9

::: {.original lang="ar"}
هنیئاً لحضرتک یا حبیب فؤادی قد شربت مآء العنایة و الحیوة من کؤوس الطاف محبوبی و محبوبک و محبوب من فی السّموات و الأرض علی شأن ینبغی ان تقول الذّرّات هنیئاً لک و مریئاً لک یا من فزت بهذا الفضل العظیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Hanīʾan li-ḥaḍratika yā ḥabīb fuʾādī. Qad sharibta māʾ al-ʿināya wa-al-ḥayāh min kuʾūs alṭāf Maḥbūbī wa-Maḥbūbika wa-Maḥbūb man fī al-samāwāt wa-al-arḍ ʿalā shaʾn yanbaghī an taqūla al-dharrāt hanīʾan laka wa-marīʾan laka yā man fuzta bi-hādhā al-faḍl al-ʿaẓīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
May it bring you joy, beloved of my heart! You have drunk the water of loving care and life from the cups of the favors of my Beloved, your Beloved, and the Beloved of all who are in the heavens and on earth, in such a measure that the atoms should say, “May it bring you joy and refreshment, you who have attained this great bounty!”
:::

### 10

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینکه مرقوم داشته بودید که جناب آقا میرزا عبداللّه ٩ ٦٦ \[بهآء اللّه\] زحمات آن محبوب را حمل نموده‌اند و طلب مکافات نمودید از حقّ جلّ جلاله در بارهٴ ایشان این مراتب در ساحت امنع اقدس اعلی عرض شد هذا ما نطق به لسان اللّه قوله عزّ اجلاله یا ورقآء مالک اسمآء میفرماید عنایتی در بارهٴ او از قلم اعلی جاری شده که ما فی العالم معادله بآن نمینماید اینست اصل مکافات که نزد حقّ جلّ جلاله محبوب بوده و هست ولکن عنایات ظاهره هم انشآءاللّه میرسد بشّره من قبلی بما نطق به لسانی و انا الآمر الحکیم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īnkih marqūm dāshtih būdīd kih Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā ʿAbduʾllāh 9 66 \[Bahāʾ Allāh\] zaḥamāt-i ān maḥbūb rā ḥaml nimūdih-and va ṭalab-i mukāfāt nimūdīd az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu dar bārih-yi īshān, īn marātib dar sāḥat-i amnaʿ-i aqdas-i aʿlā ʿarḍ shud. Hādhā mā naṭaqa bihi Lisān Allāh, qawluhu ʿazza ijlāluhu: Yā Warqāʾ, Mālik-i asmāʾ mīfarmāyad ʿināyatī dar bārih-yi ū az Qalam-i Aʿlā jārī shudih kih mā fī al-ʿālam muʿādilih bi-ān namīnamāyad. Īnast aṣl-i mukāfāt kih nazd-i Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu maḥbūb būdih va hast, va-lākin ʿināyāt-i ẓāhirih ham in shāʾ Allāh mīrasad. Bashshirhu min qibalī bi-mā naṭaqa bihi lisānī wa-anā al-Āmir al-Ḥakīm. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
You had written that Áqá Mírzá ‘Abdu’lláh, 9 66 \[the glory of God\], had borne the burdens of that beloved one, and you asked God—glorified be His glory—to reward him. These matters were presented at the most inaccessible, most holy, most exalted Court. This is what the Tongue of God uttered—exalted be His majesty: “Varqá, the Lord of Names declares: A favor has flowed from the Most Exalted Pen concerning him that nothing in the world can equal. This is the essence of recompense, which has ever been and remains beloved in the sight of God—glorified be His glory. Nevertheless, outward favors will also reach him, God willing. Give him, on My behalf, the glad tidings of what My tongue has uttered. I am the Ordainer, the All-Wise.” End.
:::

### 11

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینکه در بارهٴ قرّهٴ عین میرزا روح اللّه مرقوم داشتید عرض شد هذا ما نزل من ملکوت المشیّة و البیان قوله جلّ کبریائه یا ورقآء لک ان تقرء فی اذنه الیمنی ثلاث مرّات قد جئت بأمر اللّه و ظهرت لذکره و خلقت لخدمته العزیز المحبوب انّا ذکرناه من قبل اذ استغاثت \[امّه\] و فی هذا الحین و انا الفضّال المبین ان اذکر من قبلی امّها و بشّرها بما نطق به لسان المظلوم فی سجنه العظیم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īnkih dar bārih-yi qurrat-i ʿayn Mīrzā Rūḥuʾllāh marqūm dāshtīd ʿarḍ shud. Hādhā mā nazala min malakūt al-mashīʾa wa-al-bayān, qawluhu jalla kibriyāʾuhu: Yā Warqāʾ, laka an taqraʾa fī udhunihi al-yumnā thalātha marrāt: Qad jiʾta bi-amr Allāh wa-ẓaharta li-dhikrihi wa-khuliqta li-khidmatihi al-ʿAzīz al-Maḥbūb. Innā dhakarnāhu min qabl idh istaghāthat \[ummuhu\] wa-fī hādhā al-ḥīn wa-anā al-Faḍḍāl al-Mubīn. An udhkur min qibalī ummahā wa-bashshirhā bi-mā naṭaqa bihi lisān al-Maẓlūm fī sijnihi al-ʿaẓīm. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
What you wrote concerning the delight of the eye, Mírzá Rúḥu’lláh, was presented. This is what descended from the kingdom of will and utterance—glorified be His grandeur: “Varqá, you are to recite three times in his right ear: ‘You have come by the command of God, appeared to remember Him, and been created to serve Him, the Almighty, the Beloved.’ We made mention of him before, when \[his mother\] called for help, and at this time as well. I am the Most Bountiful, the All-Manifest. Remember her mother on My behalf, and give her the glad tidings of what the tongue of the Wronged One has uttered in His mighty prison.” End.
:::

### 12

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه مرقوم فرموده بودید در بعض ادعیه و مناجات منزله نازل و اجعله اگر در مقام رجا و اجعلنی که اضافه بقائل است تلاوت شود از تحریف محسوب یا نه عرض میشود این فقره تحریف نیست و هر دو قسم جایز است و هم‌چنین در کلمهٴ مبارکهٴ قل اللّهمّ و قل لک الحمد حذف کلمهٴ قل و ذکر آن هر دو صحیح است امّا ذکر نظر بشرافت کلمهٴ مبارکه که از فم مالک احدیّه ظاهر شده و حذف آن جایز چه که ظهور عبودیّت و اختصاص در اینمقام اظهر است
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnkih marqūm farmūdih būdīd dar baʿḍ-i adʿiyih va munājāt-i munazzalih nāzil va-ijʿalhu agar dar maqām-i rajā va-ijʿalnī kih iḍāfih bi-qāʾil ast tilāvat shavad az taḥrīf maḥsūb yā nah, ʿarḍ mīshavad īn fiqrih taḥrīf nīst va har du qism jāʾiz ast. Va hamchunīn dar kalimih-yi mubārakih-yi qul Allāhumma va qul laka al-ḥamd ḥadhf-i kalimih-yi qul va dhikr-i ān har du ṣaḥīḥ ast. Ammā dhikr naẓar bi-sharāfat-i kalimih-yi mubārakih kih az fam-i Mālik-i Aḥadiyyih ẓāhir shudih va ḥadhf-i ān jāʾiz chih kih ẓuhūr-i ʿubūdiyyat va ikhtiṣāṣ dar īn maqām aẓhar ast.
:::

::: {.translation}
You had also written that “and make him” occurs in some revealed prayers and supplications, asking whether it would be considered an alteration if, when supplicating, one recited “and make me,” which refers to the speaker. The reply is that this is not an alteration, and both forms are permissible. Likewise, in the blessed expressions “Say: O God” and “Say: Praise be to You,” both omitting the word “Say” and retaining it are correct. Retaining it honors the blessed word that has issued from the mouth of the Lord of Oneness, while omitting it is permissible because the expression of servitude and personal application is more evident in this case.
:::

### 13

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینکه در بارهٴ جناب آقا میرزا غلامعلی علیه ٩ ٦٦ \[بهآء اللّه\] مرقوم داشتید و مراتب اقبال و استقامت و خلوص و خدمتشان را این تفصیل لدی العرش معروض قال جلّت عظمته الحمد للّه بحرارت محبّت مشتعلند و بنور معرفت مزیّن کوثر وصال که اثمن جواهر عالم است و اغلی از مآء حیوان الحمد للّه بحفظ آن فائز شده و ثمرهٴ آن را ظاهر نموده انشآءاللّه همیشهٴ ایّام این آثار از او ظاهر باشد طوبی از برای نفسیکه بلقا فائز شد و به ما یلیق لهذا المقام قیام نمود انا نکبّر من هذا المقام علیه و علی احبّائی فی هناک الّذین نبذوا العالم و اخذوا ما امروا به من لدی اللّه مالک القدم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īnkih dar bārih-yi Jināb-i Āqā Mīrzā Ghulām-ʿAlī ʿalayhi 9 66 \[Bahāʾ Allāh\] marqūm dāshtīd va marātib-i iqbāl va istiqāmat va khulūṣ va khidmatishān rā, īn tafṣīl ladā al-ʿarsh maʿrūḍ. Qāla jallat ʿaẓamatuhu: Al-ḥamdu li-llāh bi-ḥarārat-i maḥabbat mushtaʿiland va bi-nūr-i maʿrifat muzayyan. Kawthar-i viṣāl kih athman-i javāhir-i ʿālam ast va aghlā az māʾ-i ḥayavān, al-ḥamdu li-llāh bi-ḥifẓ-i ān fāʾiz shudih va th amarih-yi ān rā ẓāhir nimūdih. In shāʾ Allāh hamīshih-yi ayyām īn āthār az ū ẓāhir bāshad. Ṭūbā az barā-yi nafsīkih bi-liqā fāʾiz shud va bi-mā yalīqu li-hādhā al-maqām qiyām nimūd. Innā nukabbiru min hādhā al-maqām ʿalayhi wa-ʿalā aḥibbāʾī fī hunāk alladhīna nabadhū al-ʿālam wa-akhadhū mā umirū bihi min ladā Allāh Mālik al-qidam. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
What you wrote concerning Áqá Mírzá Ghulám-‘Alí—upon him be 9 66 \[the glory of God\]—and the particulars of his devotion, steadfastness, sincerity, and service was presented before the Throne. He said—glorified be His majesty: “Praise be to God, he is aflame with the heat of love and adorned with the light of recognition. The river of reunion is the most precious of the world’s jewels and more costly than the water of life. Praise be to God, he has succeeded in preserving it and has manifested its fruit. God willing, these signs will always appear through him. Blessed is the soul who has attained the meeting and arisen to do what befits this station. From this station We send Our greeting of glorification upon him and upon My loved ones there, who have cast aside the world and embraced what they were commanded by God, the Lord of eternity.” End.
:::

### 14

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه در بارهٴ جناب آقا یوسف (من اهل نراق) علیه ٩ ٦٦ \[بهآء اللّه\] مرقوم داشتید بساحت امنع اقدس اعلی عرض شد هذا ما نزل من سمآء مشیّة ربّنا الحکیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnkih dar bārih-yi Jināb-i Āqā Yūsuf (min ahl-i Narāq) ʿalayhi 9 66 \[Bahāʾ Allāh\] marqūm dāshtīd bi-sāḥat-i amnaʿ-i aqdas-i aʿlā ʿarḍ shud. Hādhā mā nazala min samāʾ mashīʾat Rabbinā al-Ḥakīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
What you wrote concerning Áqá Yúsuf (of Naráq)—upon him be 9 66 \[the glory of God\]—was presented at the most inaccessible, most holy, most exalted Court. This is what descended from the heaven of the will of our Lord, the All-Wise.
:::

### 15

::: {.original lang="ar"}
هو الأعظم الأقدس الأبهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Huwa al-Aʿẓam al-Aqdas al-Abhā.
:::

::: {.translation}
He is the Most Great, the Most Holy, the All-Glorious.
:::

### 16

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا یوسف یذکرک المظلوم بلحن لو یسمعه کلّ الوجود من الغیب و الشّهود لیدعنّ الحیوة و البقآء مسرعین الی مقرّ الفدآء فی هذا السّبیل الّذی اذا ظهر نادی الصّراط المستقیم قد اتی الموعود بصراطه الظّاهر الواضح المبین تاللّه قد خلقت لهذا الیوم لأطوف حول هذا الصّراط و ابشّر النّاس امامه بهذا الظّهور الّذی به اخذ اللّه عهده عن النّبیّین و المرسلین یا یوسف قد اهتزّ القمیص من نسمة ارادة ربّک و به سرت نسمة اللّه علی البلدان و تضوّع عرف الرّحمن بین السّموات و الأرضین انّا ذکرناک من قبل و فی هذا الحین الّذی استوی المظلوم علی عرش اسمه العظیم انّا نوصیک و الّذین آمنوا بما تطلع به شمس الأخلاق من افق قلب سلیم یا اولیائی ان انصروا الرّحمن بالأخلاق المرضیّة هذه کلمة انزلناها فی الواح شتّی یشهد بذلک من نطق فی کلّ شأن انّه لا اله الّا انا الآمر العلیم البهآء علی اهل البهآء الّذین شربوا رحیق البقآء من کأس عطآء ربّهم الکریم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Yūsuf, yadhkuruka al-Maẓlūm bi-laḥnin law yasmaʿuhu kullu al-wujūd min al-ghayb wa-l-shuhūd la-yadaʿunna al-ḥayāta wa-l-baqāʾ musriʿīna ilā maqarri al-fidāʾ fī hādhā al-sabīl alladhī idhā ẓahara nādā al-ṣirāṭ al-mustaqīm qad atā al-Mawʿūd bi-ṣirāṭihi al-ẓāhir al-wāḍiḥ al-mubīn. Ta-Allāh qad khuliqtu li-hādhā al-yawm li-aṭūfa ḥawla hādhā al-ṣirāṭ wa-ubashshira al-nās amāmahu bi-hādhā al-ẓuhūr alladhī bihi akhadha Allāh ʿahdahu ʿan al-nabiyyīn wa-l-mursalīn. Yā Yūsuf qad ihtazza al-qamīṣ min nasamati irādati rabbika wa-bihi sarat nasamatu Allāh ʿalā al-buldān wa-taḍawwaʿa ʿarfu al-Raḥmān bayna al-samāwāt wa-l-araḍīn. Innā dhakarnāka min qablu wa-fī hādhā al-ḥīn alladhī istawā al-Maẓlūm ʿalā ʿarshi ismihi al-ʿAẓīm. Innā nūṣīka wa-alladhīna āmanū bi-mā taṭluʿu bihi shamsu al-akhlāq min ufuqi qalbin salīm. Yā awliyāʾī an inṣurū al-Raḥmān bi-l-akhlāq al-marḍiyya. Hādhihi kalimatun anzalnāhā fī alwāḥin shattā yashhadu bi-dhālika man naṭaqa fī kulli shaʾn innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-Āmir al-ʿAlīm. Al-Bahāʾ ʿalā ahli al-Bahāʾ alladhīna sharibū raḥīqa al-baqāʾ min kaʾsi ʿaṭāʾi rabbihim al-Karīm. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Yūsuf, the Wronged One remembers you in a melody which, if all existence, unseen and visible, were to hear it, would cause all to forsake life and continued existence, hastening to the abode of sacrifice in this Path. When it appeared, the Straight Path called out: “The Promised One has come with His manifest, clear, and unmistakable Path. By God, I was created for this Day, to circle around this Path and, in its presence, announce to humanity this Revelation, through which God took His covenant from the Prophets and Messengers.” O Yūsuf, the shirt has stirred in the breeze of your Lord’s will, and through it the breeze of God has wafted over the lands and the fragrance of the All-Merciful has spread between the heavens and the earths. We have remembered you before, and at this time when the Wronged One has ascended the throne of His mighty Name. We counsel you and those who believe to observe that through which the sun of character rises from the horizon of a sound heart. O My loved ones, aid the All-Merciful through praiseworthy character. This is a word We have sent down in various Tablets. To this bears witness the One who has declared in every circumstance: “There is no God but Me, the Ordainer, the All-Knowing.” Glory be upon the people of Bahāʾ who have drunk the choice wine of eternity from the cup of the bounty of their generous Lord. End.
:::

### 17

::: {.original lang="fa"}
انشآءاللّه کلّ بما ینبغی فائز شوند کینونت عالم یک لسان مشاهده میشود و بأعلی النّدآء بکلمهٴ قد اتی مالک السّمآء ناطق ولکن احدی باصغاء فائز نه الّا من شآء اللّه عجب در اینکه خود او گویا و خود او غافل سبحان من امرنی بالصّمت و ستر امره العزیز العظیم مع آنکه کشف بمقامی رسیده که السن و اقلام از ذکر آن عاجز است ایضاً سبحان من ظهر و اظهر ما اراد و نطق و انطق کلّشیء بأنّه هو المقتدر العلیم الخبیر آفتاب حقیقت بکمال ظهور ظاهر و مشرق و سراج الهی بکمال نور روشن و مجلّی مع‌ذلک کلّ محجوب و محروم از حقّ این خادم فانی میطلبد و هم بطلبید که امراض مزمنهٴ ناس را که از جهل و نادانی عارض شده بدریاق عنایت خود معالجه فرماید انّه هو المبرء الحکیم الحمد للّه اذ هو المقتدر الغفور الرّحیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
In shāʾ Allāh koll be-mā yanbaghī fāʾez shavand. Keynūnat-e ʿālam yek lesān moshāhedeh mīshavad va bi-aʿlā al-nidāʾ be-kalemeh-ye qad atā Mālik al-samāʾ nāṭeq, va-līkan aḥadī be-eṣghā fāʾez nah illā man shāʾa Allāh. ʿAjab dar īn-keh khod-e ū gūyā va khod-e ū ghāfel. Subḥāna man amaranī bi-l-ṣamt wa-satri amrihi al-ʿAzīz al-ʿAẓīm. Maʿ ān-keh kashf be-maqāmī resīdeh keh alson va aqlām az dhekr-e ān ʿājez ast. Ayḍan subḥāna man ẓahara wa-aẓhara mā arāda wa-naṭaqa wa-anṭaqa kulla shayʾ bi-annahu huwa al-Muqtadir al-ʿAlīm al-Khabīr. Āftāb-e ḥaqīqat be-kamāl-e ẓohūr ẓāher va moshreq va serāj-e elāhī be-kamāl-e nūr rowshan va mojallā. Maʿa-dhālek koll maḥjūb va maḥrūm. Az Ḥaqq īn khādem-e fānī mīṭalabad va ham beṭalabīd keh amrāḍ-e mozmenah-ye nās rā keh az jahl va nādānī ʿāreż shodeh be-deryāq-e ʿenāyat-e khod moʿālejeh farmāyad. Innahu huwa al-Mubriʾ al-Ḥakīm. Al-ḥamdu li-llāh idh huwa al-Muqtadir al-Ghafūr al-Raḥīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
God willing, may all attain what is fitting. The very being of the world is seen as a single tongue, proclaiming at the highest pitch the words, “The Lord of heaven has come,” yet no one has attained a hearing ear except those whom God wills. The wonder is that it is itself speaking and itself heedless. Glorified be the One who has commanded me to remain silent and conceal His mighty and exalted Cause, even though its disclosure has reached a degree that tongues and pens are powerless to describe. Again, glorified be the One who has appeared and revealed whatever He desired, who has spoken and caused all things to declare that He is the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Aware. The Sun of Truth is manifest and shining in the fullness of its revelation, and the divine lamp is bright and radiant in the fullness of its light. Nevertheless, all are veiled and deprived. This lowly servant asks God—and you, too, should ask—that He heal, with the antidote of His loving-kindness, the chronic illnesses that have afflicted people through ignorance and lack of understanding. He is indeed the Healer, the All-Wise. Praise be to God, for He is the All-Powerful, the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful.
:::

### 18

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه در بارهٴ جناب آقا علی محمّد ابن جناب حاجی احمد میلانی علیهما بهآء اللّه مرقوم داشتید آنچه خواسته بودید مخصوص ایشان عنایت شد و بتوسّط اخویشان ارسال گشت و حال در این حین که این عبد بتحریر این مکتوب مشغول است حضرت غصن اللّه الأکبر روحی و ذاتی و کینونتی لتراب قدومه الأطهر فداء تشریف ندارند باطراف این مدینه تشریف برده‌اند انشآءاللّه بعد از حضور و شرفیابی این خادم فانی خطّ جدید که ارسال فرموده بودند بنظر مبارکشان میرسانم و آنچه مرقوم داشته بودید معروض میدارم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īn-keh dar bāreh-ye Janāb-e Āqā ʿAlī-Moḥammad ibn-e Janāb-e Ḥājī Aḥmad-e Mīlānī, ʿalayhimā Bahāʾ Allāh, marqūm dāshtīd, āncheh khwāsteh būdīd makhṣūṣ-e īshān ʿenāyat shod va be-tavassoṭ-e akhavī-shān ersāl gasht. Va ḥāl dar īn ḥīn keh īn ʿabd be-taḥrīr-e īn maktūb mashghūl ast Ḥażrat-e Ghoṣn Allāh al-Akbar, rūḥī wa-dhātī wa-kaynūnatī li-turābi qudūmihi al-aṭhar fidāʾ, tashrīf nadārand; be-aṭrāf-e īn madīneh tashrīf bordeh-and. In shāʾ Allāh baʿd az ḥożūr va sharafyābī īn khādem-e fānī khaṭṭ-e jadīd keh ersāl farmūdeh būdand be-naẓar-e mobārak-shān mīresānam va āncheh marqūm dāshteh būdīd maʿrūż mīdāram.
:::

::: {.translation}
As to what you wrote concerning Āqā ʿAlī-Muḥammad, son of Ḥājī Aḥmad Mīlānī—upon them both be the glory of God—what you requested was graciously granted especially for him and was sent through his brother. Now, at this moment when this servant is engaged in writing this letter, His Holiness the Greater Branch of God—may my spirit, my being, and my very existence be sacrificed for the dust beneath His most pure feet—is not here; He has gone to the outskirts of this city. God willing, after His return, when this lowly servant is honored to enter His presence, I will bring the new letter that had been sent to His blessed attention and present what you had written.
:::

### 19

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه ذکر جناب آقا فرج آقا و مراتب خلوص او را ذکر فرمودید انشآءاللّه در کلّ احیان بخدمت محبوب امکان موفّق باشند و بذکر و ثنایش مؤیّد و اینکه در بارهٴ امانت استفسار رفته بود تمام و کمال رسید انّ الخادم یشهد بذلک و عن ورائه من خلقه و فطره و انطقه بثنائه الجمیل و چون ذکر ایشانرا نمودید و این عبد هم دوست داشت که ذکری از ایشان در ساحت امنع اقدس اعلی عرض شود لذا این تفصیل در لیل هفتم شهر صفر تلقاء وجه عرض شد و این آیات باهرات و کلمات تامّات از سماء عنایت منزل نازل
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īn-keh dhekr-e Janāb-e Āqā Faraj Āqā va marāteb-e kholūṣ-e ū rā dhekr farmūdīd, in shāʾ Allāh dar koll-e aḥyān be-khedmat-e Maḥbūb-e emkān movaffaq bāshand va be-dhekr va thanāyash moʾayyad. Va īn-keh dar bāreh-ye amānat estefsār rafteh būd, tamām va kamāl resīd. Inna al-khādima yashhadu bi-dhālika wa-ʿan warāʾihi man khalaqahu wa-faṭarahu wa-anṭaqahu bi-thanāʾihi al-jamīl. Va chūn dhekr-e īshān rā namūdīd va īn ʿabd ham dūst dāsht keh dhekrī az īshān dar sāḥat-e amnaʿ-e aqdas-e aʿlā ʿarż shavad, ledhā īn tafṣīl dar layl-e haftom-e shahr-e Ṣafar telqāʾ-e vajh ʿarż shod va īn āyāt-e bāherāt va kalemāt-e tāmmāt az samāʾ-e ʿenāyat-e Monzel nāzel.
:::

::: {.translation}
As to your mention of Āqā Faraj Āqā and the degree of his sincerity, God willing, may he be enabled at all times to serve the Beloved of all existence and be assisted in remembering and praising Him. As to the inquiry concerning the entrusted goods, they arrived in full and intact. This servant bears witness to this, and behind him, the One who created him, fashioned him, and caused him to voice His beautiful praise. Since you mentioned him, and this servant also wished that he should be mentioned at the most inaccessible, most holy, most exalted Court, these particulars were presented before His face on the seventh night of the month of Ṣafar, and these resplendent verses and perfect words descended from the heaven of the loving-kindness of the Revealer.
:::

### 20

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قوله جلّت عظمته هو الظّاهر المستور
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qawluhu jallat ʿaẓamatuhu: Huwa al-Ẓāhir al-Mastūr.
:::

::: {.translation}
His words—exalted be His grandeur: He is the Manifest, the Hidden.
:::

### 21

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا فرج قد ذکرناک من قبل بذکر لا تعادله کتب العالم انّ ربّک لهو المحصی العلیم ان افرح بما ذکرت مرّة بعد مرّة و توجّه الیک وجه المظلوم من هذا الحصن المتین لو تطّلع بما قدّر لک من قلمی الأعلی لتطیر بأجنحة الفرح و الابتهاج فی هذا الهوآء الّذی یسمع من هزیز اریاحه ما سمعه طلعة الظّهور فی الطّور انّ ربّک لهو الصّادق الأمین طوبی لک بما اقبلت و سمعت نداء اللّه اذ ارتفع بین السّموات و الأرضین لعمری سیفنی ما تراه العیون و تدرکه العقول و یبقی لک ما نزل من هذا القلم المبین قل لک الحمد یا من ایّدتنی علی الاقبال الی افقک و اسمعتنی ندائک و زیّنتنی بطراز الیقین اذ کان علمآء العصر فی وهم عظیم کن راضیاً بما قدّر لک و مستقیماً علی هذا الأمر الّذی اذا ظهر زلّت اقدام البالغین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Faraj qad dhakarnāka min qablu bi-dhikrin lā tuʿādiluhu kutubu al-ʿālam. Inna rabbaka la-huwa al-Muḥṣī al-ʿAlīm. An ifraḥ bi-mā dhukirta marratan baʿda marra wa-tawajjaha ilayka wajhu al-Maẓlūm min hādhā al-ḥiṣn al-matīn. Law taṭṭaliʿ bi-mā quddira laka min qalamī al-Aʿlā la-taṭīru bi-ajniḥati al-faraḥ wa-l-ibtihāj fī hādhā al-hawāʾ alladhī yusmaʿu min hazīzi aryāḥihi mā samiʿahu Ṭalʿatu al-Ẓuhūr fī al-Ṭūr. Inna rabbaka la-huwa al-Ṣādiq al-Amīn. Ṭūbā laka bi-mā aqbalta wa-samiʿta nidāʾa Allāh idh irtafaʿa bayna al-samāwāt wa-l-araḍīn. La-ʿamrī sa-yafnā mā tarāhu al-ʿuyūn wa-tudrikuhu al-ʿuqūl wa-yabqā laka mā nazala min hādhā al-qalam al-mubīn. Qul laka al-ḥamdu yā man ayyadtanī ʿalā al-iqbāl ilā ufuqika wa-asmaʿtanī nidāʾaka wa-zayyantanī bi-ṭirāzi al-yaqīn idh kāna ʿulamāʾu al-ʿaṣr fī wahmin ʿaẓīm. Kun rāḍiyan bi-mā quddira laka wa-mustaqīman ʿalā hādhā al-amr alladhī idhā ẓahara zallat aqdāmu al-bālighīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Faraj, We have remembered you before with a remembrance that the books of the world cannot equal. Your Lord is indeed the Reckoner, the All-Knowing. Rejoice that you have been remembered time after time and that the face of the Wronged One has turned toward you from this mighty fortress. Were you to become aware of what has been ordained for you by My Most Exalted Pen, you would soar on the wings of joy and gladness in this air, from the stirring of whose winds can be heard what the Countenance of Revelation heard on Sinai. Your Lord is indeed the Truthful, the Trustworthy. Blessed are you for having turned toward Him and heard the call of God as it rose between the heavens and the earths. By My life, whatever eyes see and minds comprehend will pass away, while what has descended from this perspicuous Pen will remain for you. Say: “Praise be to You, who have enabled me to turn toward Your horizon, caused me to hear Your call, and adorned me with the vesture of certitude when the learned of the age were lost in profound delusion.” Be content with what has been ordained for you, and remain steadfast in this Cause, at whose appearance the feet of those of mature understanding slipped.
:::

### 22

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و نذکر من سمّی بمحمّد الّذی قطع البرّ و البحر الی ان فاز بالبحر الأعظم فی هذا البرّ الّذی ارتفع فیه ندآء النّبیّین و المرسلین قد حضر و قام لدی الباب و سمع ندآء المظلوم و شرب من ید عطائه رحیقه المختوم کذلک ذکرناه فضلاً من عندنا و انا الفضّال الکریم البهآء علیک و علیه و علی من وجد هذا العرف العزیز البدیع انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-nadhkuru man summiya bi-Muḥammad alladhī qaṭaʿa al-barra wa-l-baḥra ilā an fāza bi-l-baḥr al-aʿẓam fī hādhā al-barr alladhī irtafaʿa fīhi nidāʾu al-nabiyyīn wa-l-mursalīn. Qad ḥaḍara wa-qāma ladā al-bāb wa-samiʿa nidāʾa al-Maẓlūm wa-shariba min yadi ʿaṭāʾihi raḥīqahu al-makhtūm. Kadhālika dhakarnāhu faḍlan min ʿindinā wa-anā al-Faḍḍāl al-Karīm. Al-Bahāʾ ʿalayka wa-ʿalayhi wa-ʿalā man wajada hādhā al-ʿarfa al-ʿazīz al-badīʿ. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
And We remember the one named Muḥammad, who crossed land and sea until he attained the Most Great Ocean in this land where the call of the Prophets and Messengers has been raised. He came, stood at the door, heard the call of the Wronged One, and drank His sealed wine from the hand of His bounty. Thus have We remembered him as a grace from Our presence, and I am the Most Bountiful, the Generous. Glory be upon you, upon him, and upon whoever has perceived this precious and wondrous fragrance. End.
:::

### 23

::: {.original lang="fa"}
بلی جناب حاجی آقا محمّد علیه ٩ ٦٦ \[بهآء اللّه\] وارد شدند و بشرف لقا فائز و مفتخر و مرّة بعد مرّة در خارج ارض سجن به ما هو المقصود یعنی بزیارت محبوب عالمیان مرزوق گشتند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Balī Janāb-e Ḥājī Āqā Moḥammad ʿalayhi 9 66 \[Bahāʾ Allāh\] vāred shodand va be-sharaf-e leqā fāʾez va moftakher va marratan baʿda marra dar khārej-e arż-e sejn be-mā huwa al-maqṣūd yaʿnī be-ziyārat-e Maḥbūb-e ʿālamiyān marzūq gashtand.
:::

::: {.translation}
Yes, Ḥājī Āqā Muḥammad—upon him be 9 66 \[the glory of God\]—arrived and attained the honor and distinction of His presence. Time after time, outside the land of the Prison, he was granted what was desired, namely, the privilege of visiting the Beloved of all the worlds.
:::

### 24

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و اینکه در بارهٴ جناب حاجی علی اصغر و شاگرد ایشان علیهما بهآء اللّه مرقوم داشتند بعد از عرض آفتاب عنایت مشرق و لوح اقدس اعظم نازل انشآءاللّه بشرفیابی آن مرزوق گردند قوله عزّ کبریائه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īn-keh dar bāreh-ye Janāb-e Ḥājī ʿAlī-Aṣghar va shāgerd-e īshān ʿalayhimā Bahāʾ Allāh marqūm dāshtand, baʿd az ʿarż āftāb-e ʿenāyat moshreq va lawḥ-e aqdas-e aʿẓam nāzel. In shāʾ Allāh be-sharafyābī-ye ān marzūq gardand. Qawluhu ʿazza kibriyāʾuhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
As to what was written concerning Ḥājī ʿAlī-Aṣghar and his apprentice—upon them both be the glory of God—after it was presented, the sun of loving-kindness shone forth and a most holy, most great Tablet descended. God willing, may they be granted the honor of receiving it. His words—exalted be His majesty:
:::

### 25

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی السّامع البصیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-smī al-Sāmiʿ al-Baṣīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
:::

### 26

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا علی قبل اصغر مالک قدم ظاهر و امم از او محجوب و آفتاب حقیقت مشرق ولکن ابصار از او محروم فرات رحمت جاری و ناس از آن ممنوع قلم اعلی متحرّک و ناطق و کل از صریرش غافل الّا من شآء اللّه هر نفسی الیوم بعرفان مالک وجود فائز شد او از نفوسی است که ذکرشان از قلم الهی در کتب قبل ثبت شد شکر کن محبوب عالمیان را که تو را مؤیّد فرمود بر قبول فضل و عطایش جمیع اهل دنیا از علما و عرفا و امرا بجان مشتاق این یوم اعزّ انور بودند و چون آفتاب ظهور اشراق نمود و ندا مرتفع شد باقبال و اصغا فائز نگشتند و علّت اعظم که امم را منع نمود علمای عصر بوده و هستند رسول از ظلم آن نفوس غافله بنوحه مشغول و آن همج رعاع باوهام خود معتکف و مسرور غفلت این نفوس سبب غفلت اهل عالم شده و ظلمشان علّت ظلم امم ولکن اصبع قدرت احجاب را خرق فرماید چنانچه نمود
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā ʿAlī qabl-e Aṣghar, Mālek-e qedam ẓāher va omam az ū maḥjūb va āftāb-e ḥaqīqat moshreq va-līkan abṣār az ū maḥrūm. Forāt-e raḥmat jārī va nās az ān mamnūʿ. Qalam-e aʿlā motaḥarrek va nāṭeq va koll az ṣarīrash ghāfel illā man shāʾa Allāh. Har nafsī al-yawm be-ʿerfān-e Mālek-e vojūd fāʾez shod ū az nofūsī ast keh dhekr-shān az qalam-e elāhī dar kotob-e qabl thabt shod. Shokr kon Maḥbūb-e ʿālamiyān rā keh to rā moʾayyad farmūd bar qabūl-e fażl va ʿaṭāyash. Jamīʿ-e ahl-e donyā az ʿolamā va ʿorafā va omarā be-jān moshtāq-e īn yawm-e aʿazz-e anvar būdand va chūn āftāb-e ẓohūr eshrāq namūd va nedā mortafeʿ shod be-eqbāl va eṣghā fāʾez nagashtand. Va ʿellat-e aʿẓam keh omam rā manʿ namūd ʿolamā-ye ʿaṣr būdeh va hastand. Rasūl az ẓolm-e ān nofūs-e ghāfeleh be-nowḥeh mashghūl va ān hamaj-e raʿāʿ be-awhām-e khod moʿtakef va masrūr. Ghaflat-e īn nofūs sabab-e ghaflat-e ahl-e ʿālam shodeh va ẓolm-shān ʿellat-e ẓolm-e omam va-līkan eṣbaʿ-e qodrat aḥjāb rā kharq farmāyad chenāncheh namūd.
:::

::: {.translation}
O ʿAlī-Aṣghar, the Lord of eternity is manifest, yet the nations are veiled from Him; the Sun of Truth is shining, yet eyes are deprived of Him. The Euphrates of mercy is flowing, yet people are kept from it. The Most Exalted Pen moves and speaks, yet all are heedless of its voice except those whom God wills. Whoever has attained recognition of the Lord of existence today is among those whose mention was inscribed by the divine Pen in the Books of old. Give thanks to the Beloved of all the worlds, who has assisted you to accept His grace and bounty. All the people of the world—scholars, mystics, and rulers—longed with all their souls for this most glorious, most luminous Day. Yet when the Sun of Revelation shone and the call was raised, they failed to turn toward Him and listen. The chief cause that has held the nations back has been, and remains, the learned of the age. The Messenger laments the oppression of those heedless souls, while that ignorant rabble clings to its own delusions and rejoices. The heedlessness of these souls has caused the heedlessness of the people of the world, and their oppression has caused the oppression of the nations. Yet the finger of power will rend the veils, even as it has already done.
:::

### 27

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و نذکر محمّد قبل حسین لیفرح بذکر اللّه المهیمن القیّوم انشآءاللّه بطراز امانت مزیّن باشی و باخلاق الهی ظاهر صفات مرضیّه بمنزلهٴ انوار است از برای افق سماء انسان هر نفسی بآن فائز شد نورش بتابد و نسبتش بحقّ جلّ جلاله ظاهر هویدا شود انشآءاللّه کلّ فائز شوند بآنچه سبب ارتفاع امر است انّه یحکم بما یرتفع به شأن الانسان فی الامکان یشهد بذلک کلّ منصف بصیر انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Wa-nadhkuru Muḥammad qabl Ḥusayn li-yafraḥa bi-dhikri Allāh al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm. In shāʾ Allāh be-ṭerāz-e amānat mozayyan bāshī va be-akhlāq-e elāhī ẓāher. Ṣefāt-e marżiyyeh be-manzaleh-ye anvār ast az barā-ye ofoq-e samāʾ-e ensān. Har nafsī be-ān fāʾez shod nūrash betābad va nesbatash be-Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu ẓāher-e hoveydā shavad. In shāʾ Allāh koll fāʾez shavand be-āncheh sabab-e ertefāʿ-e amr ast. Innahu yaḥkumu bi-mā yartafiʿu bihi shaʾnu al-insān fī al-imkān yashhadu bi-dhālika kullu munṣifin baṣīr. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
And We remember Muḥammad-Ḥusayn, that he may rejoice in the remembrance of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. God willing, may you be adorned with the vesture of trustworthiness and manifest divine character. Praiseworthy attributes are like lights for the horizon of the heaven of humanity. Whoever attains them will shine with their light, and his relationship to God—exalted be His glory—will become clear and manifest. God willing, may all attain what will exalt the Cause. He ordains that which will elevate the station of the human being in the world of existence. To this every fair-minded and discerning person bears witness. End.
:::

### 28

::: {.original lang="fa"}
الحمد للّه مائدهٴ طریّهٴ الهیّه و نعمت باقیهٴ دائمه از سماء احدیّه من غیر تعطیل جاری و نازل هر نفسی فی‌الجمله تفکّر نماید از دریای شفقت حقّ جلّ جلاله آگاه شود در لیالی و ایّام لسان عظمت بذکر دوستانش مشغول و بنصح اعدایش متکلّم عموم اهل عالم را بکمال شفقت و مرحمت بافق اعلی دعوت فرموده‌اند ولکن طوبی لمن سمع و اقبل و ویل للغافلین و الحمد للّه ربّ العالمین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Al-ḥamdu li-llāh māʾedeh-ye ṭariyyeh-ye elāhiyyeh va neʿmat-e bāqiyeh-ye dāʾemeh az samāʾ-e aḥadiyyeh min ghayr-e taʿṭīl jārī va nāzel. Har nafsī fī-l-jomleh tafakkor namāyad az daryā-ye shafaqat-e Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu āgāh shavad. Dar layālī va ayyām lesān-e ʿaẓamat be-dhekr-e dūstānash mashghūl va be-noṣḥ-e aʿdāyash motakallem. ʿOmūm-e ahl-e ʿālam rā be-kamāl-e shafaqat va marḥamat be-ofoq-e aʿlā daʿvat farmūdeh-and va-līkan ṭūbā li-man samiʿa wa-aqbala wa-waylun li-l-ghāfilīn wa-l-ḥamdu li-llāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
Praise be to God, the fresh divine banquet and the enduring, everlasting bounty flow and descend without interruption from the heaven of oneness. Anyone who reflects even a little will become aware of the ocean of God’s compassion—exalted be His glory. By night and day, the Tongue of Grandeur is occupied with remembering His friends and speaking counsel to His enemies. With the utmost compassion and mercy, He has summoned all the people of the world to the Most Exalted Horizon. Yet blessed is the one who has heard and turned toward Him, and woe to the heedless. Praise be to God, the Lord of all the worlds.
:::

### 29

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه در بارهٴ ابن جناب من صعد الی اللّه الّذی سمّی برضا الرّوح فی کتاب الأسمآء ذکر فرمودید عرض شد و این لوح امنع اقدس مخصوص ایشان از سماء مشیّت محبوب امکان نازل قوله عزّ کبریائه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īn-keh dar bāreh-ye ibn-e Janāb-e man ṣaʿida ilā Allāh alladhī summiya bi-Riḍā al-Rūḥ fī Kitāb al-Asmāʾ dhekr farmūdīd, ʿarż shod va īn lawḥ-e amnaʿ-e aqdas makhṣūṣ-e īshān az samāʾ-e mashiyyat-e Maḥbūb-e emkān nāzel. Qawluhu ʿazza kibriyāʾuhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
What you mentioned concerning the son of the honored one who has ascended to God, who was named Riḍā al-Rūḥ in the Book of Names, was presented, and this most inaccessible, most holy Tablet descended especially for him from the heaven of the will of the Beloved of all existence. His words—exalted be His majesty:
:::

### 30

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی المشرق من افق البیان
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-smī al-Mushriq min ufuqi al-bayān.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, shining from the horizon of utterance.
:::

### 31

::: {.original lang="ar"}
ذکر انزله الرّحمن لمن اقبل الی الوجه فی یوم فیه تشتّت شمل العالم و ارتفع العویل بین السّموات و الأرضین لیفرح بذکری الّذی جعله اللّه رحیق الحیوان لأهل الامکان و روح الأعظم بین الأمم و العطیّة الکبری للوری تعالی مالک الأدیان الّذی اتی من سمآء الفضل بعدل مبین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dhikrun anzalahu al-Raḥmān li-man aqbala ilā al-wajh fī yawmin fīhi tashtattata shamlu al-ʿālam wa-irtafaʿa al-ʿawīl bayna al-samāwāt wa-l-araḍīn li-yafraḥa bi-dhikrī alladhī jaʿalahu Allāh raḥīqa al-ḥayawān li-ahli al-imkān wa-rūḥa al-aʿẓam bayna al-umam wa-l-ʿaṭiyyata al-kubrā li-l-warā. Taʿālā Mālik al-adyān alladhī atā min samāʾi al-faḍl bi-ʿadlin mubīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
A remembrance sent down by the All-Merciful for the one who has turned toward the Face on a day when the unity of the world has been shattered and lamentation has risen between the heavens and the earths, that he may rejoice in My remembrance, which God has made the choice wine of life for the people of existence, the Most Great Spirit among the nations, and the supreme gift to humanity. Exalted is the Lord of religions, who has come from the heaven of grace with manifest justice.
:::

### 32

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا هادی قد ارسلنا القائم انکره علمآء العصر کلّها الّا من شآء اللّه ربّ العالمین فلمّا مضت سنین متوالیات اظهرنا نفسنا باسمنا القیّوم ولکنّ القوم اعرضوا الی ان افتوا علینا بظلم ناح به الرّوح الأمین قد اخذونا مرّة بعد مرّة و حبسونا کرّة بعد کرّة تارة فی ارض الطّآء و اخری فی المیم و مرّة اخری فی الطّآء و فی ارض السّرّ و هذا السّجن العظیم انّا نشکر اللّه فی کلّ ذلک و قبلنا فی سبیله ما ورد علینا من الّذین غفلوا عن اللّه المقتدر القدیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Hādī, qad arsalnā al-Qāʾim, ankarahu ʿulamāʾ al-ʿaṣr kulluhā illā man shāʾa Allāh rabb al-ʿālamīn. Fa-lammā maḍat sinīn mutawāliyāt aẓharnā nafsanā bi-sminā al-Qayyūm, wa-lākinna al-qawm aʿraḍū ilā an aftaw ʿalaynā bi-ẓulm nāḥa bihi al-Rūḥ al-Amīn. Qad akhadhūnā marratan baʿda marra wa-ḥabasūnā karratan baʿda karra, tāratan fī arḍ al-Ṭāʾ wa-ukhrā fī al-Mīm wa-marratan ukhrā fī al-Ṭāʾ wa-fī arḍ al-Sirr wa-hādhā al-sijn al-ʿaẓīm. Innā nashkur Allāh fī kull dhālik wa-qabilnā fī sabīlihi mā warada ʿalaynā min alladhīna ghafalū ʿan Allāh al-Muqtadir al-Qadīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Hādī! We sent forth the Qāʾim, but all the scholars of the age denied Him, except those whom God, the Lord of the worlds, willed otherwise. When successive years had passed, We manifested Our own Self in Our name, the Self-Subsisting. Yet the people turned away, until they issued rulings against Us with such injustice that the Faithful Spirit lamented over it. They seized Us time after time and imprisoned Us again and again: once in the land of Ṭāʾ, another time in Mīm, once again in Ṭāʾ, and in the Land of Mystery and this mighty prison. Through all this We thank God, and in His path We have accepted whatever befell Us at the hands of those who were heedless of God, the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent.
:::

### 33

::: {.original lang="ar"}
انّا نذکر اباک الّذی به ابتسم ثغر العرفان فی الامکان و فاز بلقآء اللّه العلیم الحکیم انّا ذکرناه بما لا یعادله شیء فی الأرض و نذکره بدوام الملک و المکوت و انا المشفق الکریم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Innā nadhkur abāka alladhī bihi ibtasama thaghr al-ʿirfān fī al-imkān wa-fāza bi-liqāʾ Allāh al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm. Innā dhakarnāhu bi-mā lā yuʿādiluhu shayʾ fī al-arḍ wa-nadhkuruhu bi-dawām al-mulk wa-\[corrupted text\] wa-anā al-Mushfiq al-Karīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
We remember your father, through whom the mouth of recognition smiled in the world of existence, and who attained the presence of God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. We have remembered him with that which nothing on earth can equal, and We will remember him as long as the dominion and \[corrupted original text\] endure. I am the Compassionate, the All-Bountiful.
:::

### 34

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا رضا ان افرح بما یذکرک مالک الأسمآء من شطر السّجن بذکر ینجذب منه الملأ الأعلی و سکّان الفردوس و الّذین طافوا العرش فی البکور و الأصیل طوبی لمن اقبل الیک و زارک بما نزل من قلمی الأعلی و حضر تلقآء قبرک الشّریف انت الّذی اقبلت الی افق اللّه و توجّهت الیه فی یوم فیه اعرض عنه کلّ غافل بعید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Riḍā, an ifraḥ bi-mā yadhkuruka Mālik al-Asmāʾ min shaṭr al-sijn bi-dhikr yanjadhibu minhu al-malaʾ al-aʿlā wa-sukkān al-firdaws wa-alladhīna ṭāfū al-ʿarsh fī al-bukūr wa-al-aṣīl. Ṭūbā li-man aqbala ilayka wa-zāraka bi-mā nazala min qalamī al-aʿlā wa-ḥaḍara tilqāʾ qabrika al-sharīf. Anta alladhī aqbalta ilā ufuq Allāh wa-tawajjahta ilayhi fī yawm fīhi aʿraḍa ʿanhu kull ghāfil baʿīd.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Riḍā! Rejoice that the Lord of Names remembers you from the direction of the prison with a remembrance that enraptures the heavenly Concourse, the inhabitants of Paradise, and those who circle the Throne at morning and evening. Blessed is whoever turns toward you, visits you with what has been sent down from My Most Exalted Pen, and stands before your noble grave. You are the one who turned toward the horizon of God and directed yourself toward Him on a day when everyone heedless and far removed turned away from Him.
:::

### 35

::: {.original lang="ar"}
اوّل ذکر نطق به لسان مالک القدم بین الأمم علیک یا ایّها النّاطق بذکر اللّه و المتوجّه الی الوجه بعد فنآء الأشیآء اشهد انّک شربت الرّحیق المختوم من ید اسمه القیّوم و نبذت الأوهام عن ورائک و اخذت الایقان بقوّة من لدی اللّه القویّ الغالب العزیز الحمید طوبی لک بما تزیّن رأسک باکلیل القبول و هیکلک بطراز عنایة اللّه فی یومه البدیع البهآء و الذّکر و الرّوح و السّلام و النّفحات المتضوّعة من قمیص رحمة ربّک علیک یا من فزت بعنایة ربّک اذ اتی بسلطان مبین انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Awwal dhikr naṭaqa bihi lisān Mālik al-Qidam bayna al-umam ʿalayka yā ayyuhā al-nāṭiq bi-dhikr Allāh wa-al-mutawajjih ilā al-wajh baʿda fanāʾ al-ashyāʾ. Ashhadu annaka sharibta al-raḥīq al-makhtūm min yad ismihi al-Qayyūm wa-nabadhta al-awhām ʿan warāʾika wa-akhadhta al-īqān bi-quwwa min ladā Allāh al-Qawī al-Ghālib al-ʿAzīz al-Ḥamīd. Ṭūbā laka bi-mā tazayyana raʾsuka bi-iklīl al-qabūl wa-haykaluka bi-ṭirāz ʿināyat Allāh fī yawmihi al-badīʿ. Al-bahāʾ wa-al-dhikr wa-al-rūḥ wa-al-salām wa-al-nafaḥāt al-mutaḍawwiʿa min qamīṣ raḥmat rabbika ʿalayka yā man fuzta bi-ʿināyat rabbika idh atā bi-sulṭān mubīn. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
May the first remembrance uttered by the tongue of the Lord of eternity among the nations rest upon you, O you who speak in remembrance of God and turn toward the Face after all things have passed away. I bear witness that you drank the sealed wine from the hand of His name, the Self-Subsisting, cast vain imaginings behind you, and held fast to certitude through a strength from God, the Strong, the All-Subduing, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy. Blessed are you, for your head has been adorned with the crown of acceptance and your person with the ornament of God's loving care in His wondrous Day. Glory, remembrance, spirit, peace, and the fragrant breezes wafting from the garment of your Lord's mercy rest upon you, O you who attained your Lord's loving care when He came with manifest authority. End.
:::

### 36

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینکه ذکر اهل سیسان و نفوس مشتعله نمودید انشآءاللّه کلّ بعنایت حقّ فائز شوند و این دعا این حین باستجابت فائز گشت یک لوح امنع اقدس مخصوص آن نفوس مقبلهٴ موقنه نازل و از قبل هم بالواح الهی فائز گشته‌اند قوله تعالی شأنه و جلّ کبریائه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īnke dhekr-e ahl-e Sīsān va nofūs-e moshtaʿele namūdīd, in shāʾ Allāh koll be-ʿenāyat-e Ḥaqq fāʾez shavand, va īn doʿā īn ḥīn be-estejābat fāʾez gasht. Yek lawḥ-e amnaʿ-e aqdas makhṣūṣ-e ān nofūs-e moqbele-ye mūqene nāzel va az qabl ham be-alvāḥ-e elāhī fāʾez gashte-and. Qawluhu taʿālā shaʾnuhu wa-jalla kibriyāʾuhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
You mentioned the people of Sīsān and those enkindled souls. God willing, may they all attain the loving care of the True One. This prayer has at this very moment been answered. A most exalted, most holy Tablet has been sent down especially for those souls who have turned toward Him with certitude, and they have previously also received divine Tablets. His words—exalted is His station and glorious His majesty:
:::

### 37

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بنام بینای یکتا
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Be-nām-e Bīnā-ye Yektā.
:::

::: {.translation}
In the name of the One, the All-Seeing.
:::

### 38

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اولیای سیسان را بعنایت رحمن بشارت میدهم جمیع تحت لحاظ مرحمت بوده و هستند و در ظلّ سدرهٴ باسقهٴ ربّانیّه مقرّ گزیده‌اند در فضل الهی تفکّر نمائید علمای دنیا که خود را اعلم و اعرف و افقه و اعلای اهل عالم میشمردند بقطره‌ئی از بحر بیان فائز نشدند و بذکری لدی الرّحمن مفتخر نگشتند ولکن آن نفوس از عنایت حقّ جلّ جلاله بمقامی فائز گشتند که قلم اعلی در سجن اعظم بذکرشان مشغول تعالی هذا المقام الأسمی الأسنی و تعالی هذا الذّکر الأعظم الأعلی که تواند از عهدهٴ شکر الهی برآید قسم بآفتاب حقیقت که از افق سجن طالع است اگر نفسی بعدد ذرّات دارای لسان باشد و از اوّل لا اوّل له الی آخر لا آخر له شکر و ثنا گوید هرآینه بیک یا عبدی که از مطلع بیان ظاهر شود معادله ننماید و حال لسان رحمن به یا احبّائی فی سیسان ناطق است انشآءاللّه کلّ اینمقام را عظیم شمرند و جهد نمایند تا بعظمتش آگاه شوند و اگر فی‌الحقیقه باینمقام فائز گردند خود را از عالم و عالمیان فارغ مشاهده نمایند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Awliyā-ye Sīsān rā be-ʿenāyat-e Raḥmān beshārat mīdaham. Jamīʿ taḥt-e leḥāẓ-e marḥamat būde va hastand va dar ẓell-e sedre-ye bāseqe-ye rabbānīye maqar gozīde-and. Dar faḍl-e elāhī tafakkor namāyīd. ʿOlamā-ye donyā ke khod rā aʿlam va aʿraf va afqah va aʿlā-ye ahl-e ʿālam mīshomordand be-qaṭreʾī az baḥr-e bayān fāʾez nashodand va be-dhekrī ladā al-Raḥmān moftakher nagashtand, va-lāken ān nofūs az ʿenāyat-e Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu be-maqāmī fāʾez gashtand ke Qalam-e Aʿlā dar Sejn-e Aʿẓam be-dhekrashān mashghūl. Taʿālā hādhā al-maqām al-asmā al-asnā wa-taʿālā hādhā al-dhikr al-aʿẓam al-aʿlā. Ke tavānad az ʿohde-ye shokr-e elāhī barāyad? Qasam be-Āftāb-e Ḥaqīqat ke az ofoq-e sejn ṭāleʿ ast, agar nafsī be-ʿadad-e dharrāt dārā-ye lesān bāshad va az avval-e lā awwala lahu ilā ākhar-e lā ākhira lahu shokr va thanā gūyad, har-āyene be-yek yā ʿabdī ke az maṭlaʿ-e bayān ẓāher shavad moʿādele nanamāyad. Va ḥāl Lesān-e Raḥmān be-yā aḥibbāʾī fī Sīsān nāṭeq ast. In shāʾ Allāh koll īn maqām rā ʿaẓīm shomorand va jahd namāyand tā be-ʿaẓamatash āgāh shavand, va agar fī al-ḥaqīqe be-īn maqām fāʾez gardand khod rā az ʿālam va ʿālamiyān fāregh moshāhede namāyand.
:::

::: {.translation}
I give the friends in Sīsān the glad tidings of the loving care of the All-Merciful. All have been, and remain, under His merciful gaze, and have made their home beneath the shade of the lofty, divine Lote Tree. Reflect on the grace of God. The scholars of the world, who considered themselves the most learned, the most discerning, the most versed in religious law, and the most exalted of the world's people, did not attain a single drop from the ocean of utterance, nor were they honored with a mention in the presence of the All-Merciful. Yet through the loving care of the True One—glorious is His glory—those souls have attained a station such that the Most Exalted Pen is occupied with their remembrance in the Most Great Prison. Exalted is this loftiest, most radiant station, and exalted is this greatest, most sublime remembrance! Who can adequately thank God? I swear by the Sun of Truth shining from the horizon of the prison: if a soul possessed as many tongues as there are atoms and offered thanks and praise from the beginning that has no beginning to the end that has no end, it would assuredly not equal a single “O My servant” issuing from the Dawning-Place of utterance. And now the tongue of the All-Merciful is proclaiming, “O My loved ones in Sīsān!” God willing, may all regard this station as great and strive to become aware of its greatness. If they truly attain this station, they will see themselves freed from the world and all its peoples.
:::

### 39

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ایدوستان محبوب امکان شما را ذکر مینماید و مخصوص هر یک در ملکوت فضل مقامی معیّن فرموده ان افرحوا بما یبشّرکم اللّه به انّه لهو الغفور الرّحیم قد ذکرناکم من قبل بآیات ما اطّلع بها الّا اللّه المحصی العلیم انّا نأمرکم بالحکمة و نهدیکم الی صراطه المستقیم تمسّکوا بحبل الحکمة و داروا مع العباد لئلّا یرتفع ضوضآء الّذین غفلوا عن امری العظیم البهآء علیکم و علی امائی فی هناک اللّائی سمعن و اجبن ما ارتفع من افقی المنیر انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Ey dūstān, Maḥbūb-e emkān shomā rā dhekr mīnamāyad va makhṣūṣ-e har yek dar malakūt-e faḍl maqāmī moʿayyan farmūde. An ifraḥū bi-mā yubashshirukum Allāh bihi, innahu la-huwa al-Ghafūr al-Raḥīm. Qad dhakarnākum min qabl bi-āyāt mā iṭṭalaʿa bihā illā Allāh al-Muḥṣī al-ʿAlīm. Innā naʾmurukum bi-al-ḥikma wa-nahdīkum ilā ṣirāṭihi al-mustaqīm. Tamassakū bi-ḥabl al-ḥikma wa-dārū maʿa al-ʿibād li-allā yartafiʿa ḍawḍāʾ alladhīna ghafalū ʿan amrī al-ʿaẓīm. Al-bahāʾ ʿalaykum wa-ʿalā imāʾī fī hunāka allāʾī samiʿna wa-ajabna mā irtafaʿa min ufuqī al-munīr. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O friends! The Beloved of all existence remembers you and has assigned a particular station to each of you in the kingdom of grace. Rejoice in the glad tidings God gives you. He is indeed the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful. We have remembered you before in verses of which none but God, the All-Reckoning, the All-Knowing, is aware. We enjoin wisdom upon you and guide you to His straight path. Hold fast to the cord of wisdom and deal tactfully with people, so that no clamor may arise from those who are heedless of My mighty Cause. Glory rest upon you and upon My handmaidens there who have heard and answered what has risen from My luminous horizon. End.
:::

### 40

::: {.original lang="fa"}
مخصوص دوستان الهی در سیسان از قبل نازل شده آنچه عرفش از عالم منقطع نشود الحمد للّه غمام فضل بشأنی مرتفع است که هر ذرّه از ذرّات را احاطه نموده تا چه رسد بنفوس مقبلهٴ مطمئنّه که از کأس ایقان نوشیده‌اند و بمقام اطمینان فائز گشته‌اند لهم مقام عند ربّهم العلیم الحکیم اینخادم بکمال عجز و انکسار خدمت هر یک از ایشان تکبیر میرساند اظهاراً لخلوصی لهم و اعلاناً لحبّی ایّاهم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Makhṣūṣ-e dūstān-e elāhī dar Sīsān az qabl nāzel shode ānche ʿarfash az ʿālam monqaṭeʿ nashavad. Al-ḥamdu li-llāh ghamām-e faḍl be-shaʾnī mortafeʿ ast ke har dharre az dharrāt rā eḥāṭe namūde, tā che resad be-nofūs-e moqbele-ye moṭmaʾenne ke az kaʾs-e īqān nūshīde-and va be-maqām-e eṭmīnān fāʾez gashte-and. Lahum maqām ʿinda rabbihim al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm. Īn khādem be-kamāl-e ʿajz va enkesār khedmat-e har yek az īshān takbīr mīresānad, iẓhāran li-khulūṣī lahum wa-iʿlānan li-ḥubbī iyyāhum.
:::

::: {.translation}
There has previously been sent down especially for the friends of God in Sīsān that whose fragrance will never cease to pervade the world. Praise be to God, the cloud of grace has risen in such a way that it has encompassed every atom—how much more those assured souls who have turned toward Him, drunk from the cup of certitude, and attained the station of assurance. They have a station with their Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. With utter helplessness and humility, this servant conveys to each of them the greeting “God is most great,” as an expression of my devotion to them and a declaration of my love for them.
:::

### 41

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اینکه در ذکر احبّای الهی و اجتماع ایشان در بیت جناب آقا محمّد حسن علیهم و علیه بهآء اللّه مرقوم داشتند این مراتب در پیشگاه حضور محبوب عالمیان عرض شد این لوح امنع اقدس مخصوص آن نفوس و صاحب بیت از افق ارادهٴ مالک احدیّه ظاهر و مشرق انشآءاللّه از انوارش منوّر شوند و از دریای معانیش بیآشامند انّه لهو الفضّال الکریم قوله عزّ کبریائه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īnke dar dhekr-e aḥebbā-ye elāhī va ejtemāʿ-e īshān dar bayt-e Janāb-e Āqā Moḥammad Ḥasan, ʿalayhim wa-ʿalayhi Bahāʾ Allāh, marqūm dāshtand, īn marāteb dar pīshgāh-e ḥoḍūr-e Maḥbūb-e ʿālamiyān ʿarḍ shod. Īn lawḥ-e amnaʿ-e aqdas makhṣūṣ-e ān nofūs va ṣāḥeb-e bayt az ofoq-e erāde-ye Mālek-e Aḥadīye ẓāher va moshreq. In shāʾ Allāh az anvārash monavvar shavand va az daryā-ye maʿānīsh biyāshāmand. Innahu la-huwa al-Faḍḍāl al-Karīm. Qawluhu ʿazza kibriyāʾuhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
What you wrote concerning the friends of God and their gathering in the home of Āqā Muḥammad Ḥasan—may the glory of God rest upon them and upon him—was presented in the presence of the Beloved of all peoples. This most exalted, most holy Tablet, intended especially for those souls and the owner of the house, has appeared and shone forth from the horizon of the will of the Lord of Oneness. God willing, may they be illumined by its lights and drink from the ocean of its meanings. He is indeed the All-Bountiful, the Generous. His words—exalted is His majesty:
:::

### 42

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی المبیّن العلیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-smī al-Mubayyin al-ʿAlīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, the All-Expounding, the All-Knowing.
:::

### 43

::: {.original lang="ar"}
لسان العظمة یبشّر الّذین اجتمعوا لذکر اللّه و شربوا باسمه کوثر الثّنآء اولئک عباد مخلصون یصلّین علیهم الملأ الفردوس الأعلی و عن ورائهم ملائکة مقرّبون طوبی لأذن فازت باصغآء آیاتی و لبیت ارتفع فیه ذکری الممنوع قد خلقنا العباد لذکری و ثنائی و خدمة امری فلمّا اظهرت نفسی اعرضوا عنّی الّا من شآء اللّه المهیمن القیّوم یا احبّآء الرّحمن قوموا علی الذّکر و الثّنآء علی شأن لا تمنعکم الدّنیا کذلک یذکرکم مالک الأسمآء انّه لهو المشفق العزیز الودود ان افرحوا بما ذکرتم لدی المظلوم و نزّل لکم هذا الکتاب المحتوم البهآء علیکم و علی الّذین ما خوّفتهم سطوة العلمآء عن اللّه ربّ ما کان و ما یکون انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Lisān al-ʿaẓama yubashshir alladhīna ijtamaʿū li-dhikr Allāh wa-sharibū bi-smihi kawthar al-thanāʾ. Ulāʾika ʿibād mukhliṣūn, yuṣallīna ʿalayhim al-malaʾ al-firdaws al-aʿlā wa-ʿan warāʾihim malāʾika muqarrabūn. Ṭūbā li-udhun fāzat bi-iṣghāʾ āyātī wa-li-bayt irtafaʿa fīhi dhikrī al-mamnūʿ. Qad khalaqnā al-ʿibād li-dhikrī wa-thanāʾī wa-khidmat amrī, fa-lammā aẓhartu nafsī aʿraḍū ʿannī illā man shāʾa Allāh al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm. Yā aḥibbāʾ al-Raḥmān, qūmū ʿalā al-dhikr wa-al-thanāʾ ʿalā shaʾn lā tamnaʿukum al-dunyā. Kadhālika yadhkurukum Mālik al-Asmāʾ, innahu la-huwa al-Mushfiq al-ʿAzīz al-Wadūd. An ifraḥū bi-mā dhukirtum ladā al-Maẓlūm wa-nuzzila lakum hādhā al-kitāb al-maḥtūm. Al-bahāʾ ʿalaykum wa-ʿalā alladhīna mā khawwafathum saṭwat al-ʿulamāʾ ʿan Allāh rabb mā kāna wa-mā yakūn. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
The tongue of grandeur gives glad tidings to those who have gathered to remember God and have drunk, in His name, from the Kawthar of praise. These are sincere servants, upon whom the concourse of the highest Paradise bestows blessings, and beyond them the angels brought near. Blessed is the ear that has attained to hearing My verses, and the house in which My forbidden remembrance has been raised. We created humanity to remember Me, praise Me, and serve My Cause. Yet when I manifested Myself, they turned away from Me, except those whom God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting, willed otherwise. O loved ones of the All-Merciful! Arise to remembrance and praise in such a way that the world cannot hinder you. Thus does the Lord of Names remember you. He is indeed the Compassionate, the Almighty, the All-Loving. Rejoice that you have been remembered in the presence of the Wronged One and that this irrevocable Tablet has been sent down for you. Glory rest upon you and upon those whom the might of the scholars has not frightened away from God, the Lord of all that has been and all that is to come. End.
:::

### 44

::: {.original lang="fa"}
اسامی آن نفوس مطمئنّه که آنجناب ذکر نمودند و در آن بیت لأجل ذکر اللّه حاضر شدند عرض شد و هر یک بفضل اللّه و منّه بفیوضات حقیقی فائز گشتند یعطی و یمنع و هو المقتدر القدیر ثمّ الحمد للّه و المنّة که ذکر جناب ع‌ب علیه بهآء اللّه شده و میشود لحاظ عنایت بایشان متوجّه در همین ایّام این فانی مکرّر ذکرشانرا از لسان عظمت استماع نمود انشآءاللّه مؤیّد شوند بحکمت منزله یشهد الخادم بأنّه فاز بالاقبال الی اللّه و حبّه و خدمته و ذکره و ثنائه و البتّه بمکافات این اعمال فائز خواهند شد انّ ربّنا الرّحمن لهو الغفور الکریم و هو العطوف الرّحیم و هو المعطی المشفق السّمیع البصیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Asāmī-ye ān nofūs-e moṭmaʾenne ke ān janāb dhekr namūdand va dar ān bayt li-ajl dhikr Allāh ḥāḍer shodand ʿarḍ shod, va har yek be-faḍl-e Allāh va manneh be-foyūḍāt-e ḥaqīqī fāʾez gashtand. Yuʿṭī wa-yamnaʿ wa-huwa al-Muqtadir al-Qadīr. Thumma al-ḥamdu li-llāh wa-al-minna ke dhekr-e Janāb-e ʿ. B., ʿalayhi Bahāʾ Allāh, shode va mīshavad. Leḥāẓ-e ʿenāyat be-īshān motavajjeh. Dar hamīn ayyām īn fānī mokarrar dhekrashān rā az Lesān-e ʿAẓamat estemāʿ namūd. In shāʾ Allāh moʾayyad shavand be-ḥekmat-e monzale. Yashhad al-khādim bi-annahu fāza bi-al-iqbāl ilā Allāh wa-ḥubbihi wa-khidmatihi wa-dhikrihi wa-thanāʾihi. Va al-batte be-mokāfāt-e īn aʿmāl fāʾez khvāhand shod. Inna rabbanā al-Raḥmān la-huwa al-Ghafūr al-Karīm wa-huwa al-ʿAṭūf al-Raḥīm wa-huwa al-Muʿṭī al-Mushfiq al-Samīʿ al-Baṣīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
The names of those assured souls whom you mentioned, and who attended that house for the remembrance of God, were presented, and each, through God's grace and bounty, received true outpourings of grace. He gives and withholds, and He is the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent. Praise and gratitude be to God, moreover, that ʿ. B.—may the glory of God rest upon him—has been and continues to be remembered. The gaze of loving care is directed toward him. In these very days, this lowly one has repeatedly heard him mentioned by the Tongue of Grandeur. God willing, may he be aided through the wisdom that has been sent down. This servant bears witness that he has attained to turning toward God, loving Him, serving Him, remembering Him, and praising Him. He will assuredly receive the recompense for these deeds. Our Lord, the All-Merciful, is indeed the Ever-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful. He is the Tenderhearted, the Merciful, and He is the Bestower, the Compassionate, the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
:::

### 45

::: {.original lang="ar"}
و در مراسلهٴ دیگر آنجناب ذکر مرفوع جناب ذبیح علیه بهآء اللّه و رحمته بود لوحی مخصوص جناب آقا میرزا غلامعلی علیه ٩ ٦٦ \[بهآء اللّه\] نازل و ذکر من صعد در او از قلم اعلی جاری انشآءاللّه لم‌یزل و لایزال بعنایت حقّ فائز باشند قوله جلّ کبریائه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va dar morāsele-ye dīgar-e ān janāb dhekr-e marfūʿ-e Janāb-e Dhabīḥ, ʿalayhi Bahāʾ Allāh wa-raḥmatuhu, būd. Lawḥī makhṣūṣ-e Janāb-e Āqā Mīrzā GholāmʿAlī, ʿalayhi 9 66 \[Bahāʾ Allāh\], nāzel va dhekr-e man ṣaʿida dar ū az Qalam-e Aʿlā jārī. In shāʾ Allāh lam-yazal va lā-yazāl be-ʿenāyat-e Ḥaqq fāʾez bāshand. Qawluhu jalla kibriyāʾuhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
In your other letter there was an exalted mention of Dhabīḥ—may the glory of God and His mercy rest upon him. A Tablet has been sent down especially for Āqā Mīrzā Ghulām-ʿAlī—upon him be 9 66 \[the glory of God\]—and in it the remembrance of the one who ascended has flowed from the Most Exalted Pen. God willing, may they always and forever receive the loving care of the True One. His words—glorious is His majesty:
:::

### 46

::: {.original lang="ar"}
هو الأقدم الأعظم الأبهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Huwa al-Aqdam al-Aʿẓam al-Abhā.
:::

::: {.translation}
He is the Most Ancient, the Most Great, the Most Glorious.
:::

### 47

::: {.original lang="ar"}
قد طار المعانی الف سنة لیصل الی مقام هذا اللّفظ الّذی تفوّه به لسان اللّه المهیمن القیّوم قد طار الرّوح فی قرون لا یحصیها الّا اللّه لیزور هذا الجسم الّذی یمشی فی الفردوس الأعلی الّذی سمّی بالسّجن الأعظم بلسان اللّه مالک الغیب و الشّهود شهد اللّه لنفسه انّه ظهر بالحقّ و ینطق فی هذا القصر الّذی اقتصرت فیه الأمور بذکر هذا الذّکر الأعظم الّذی به ظهر الفزع الأکبر فی العالم و ناح کلّ غافل محجوب
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Qad ṭāra al-maʿānī alf sana li-yaṣila ilā maqām hādhā al-lafẓ alladhī tafawwaha bihi Lisān Allāh al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm. Qad ṭāra al-rūḥ fī qurūn lā yuḥṣīhā illā Allāh li-yazūra hādhā al-jism alladhī yamshī fī al-firdaws al-aʿlā alladhī summiya bi-al-Sijn al-Aʿẓam bi-Lisān Allāh Mālik al-ghayb wa-al-shuhūd. Shahida Allāh li-nafsihi annahu ẓahara bi-al-ḥaqq wa-yanṭiqu fī hādhā al-qaṣr alladhī iqtaṣarat fīhi al-umūr bi-dhikr hādhā al-Dhikr al-Aʿẓam alladhī bihi ẓahara al-fazaʿ al-akbar fī al-ʿālam wa-nāḥa kull ghāfil maḥjūb.
:::

::: {.translation}
Meanings have soared for a thousand years to reach the station of this word uttered by the Tongue of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. The spirit has soared through centuries that none but God can number to visit this body that walks in the highest Paradise, which the Tongue of God, the Lord of the unseen and the seen, has named the Most Great Prison. God bears witness to His own Self that He has appeared in truth and speaks, in this palace where affairs have been curtailed, in remembrance of this Most Great Remembrance, through whom the greatest terror has appeared in the world and every heedless, veiled soul has lamented.
:::

### 48

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا غلام یذکرک مولی الأنام و یذکّرک اذ کنت لدی الوجه قائماً لدی باب فتح باصبع القدرة علی من فی السّموات و الأرض کذلک نطق جمال القدم فی هذا المقام المرفوع ان انظر ثمّ اذکر اذ سمعت ندآء ربّک و تکلّم معک بالشّفقة و العنایة انّ ربّک لهو العزیز الودود و نذکر اباک الّذی فاز بطراز الایقان و شهد بما شهد اللّه و نطق بما نزل فی لوح المحفوظ نشهد انّه ما توقّف فی هذا الأمر و اذا سمع النّدآء من شطر ربّه مالک الأسمآء قال لبیّک لبیّک یا اله الغیب و الشّهود قد سمع و اجاب و خضع اذ اتاه الأمر من مشرق وحی ربّه مالک الوجود انّا زیّنّا سمآء قلبه بنیّر حبّی العزیز المحبوب قد فاز بالرّحیق الأطهر اذ کان العراق منظری الأکبر اخذ و شرب باسمی المبارک العزیز الممنوع مرّة فاز فی العراق و اخری اذ اخرجنا الغافلون من ارض السّرّ کذلک ینطق جمال القدم امام وجه العالم ولکنّ الأمم اکثرهم لا یفقهون
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Ghulām, yadhkuruka Mawlā al-anām wa-yudhakkiruka idh kunta ladā al-wajh qāʾiman ladā bāb futiḥa bi-iṣbaʿ al-qudra ʿalā man fī al-samāwāt wa-l-arḍ. Kadhālika naṭaqa Jamāl al-Qidam fī hādhā al-maqām al-marfūʿ. An unẓur thumma udhkur idh samiʿta nidāʾ rabbika wa-takallama maʿaka bi-l-shafaqa wa-l-ʿināya. Inna rabbaka la-huwa al-ʿAzīz al-Wadūd. Wa-nadhkuru abāka alladhī fāza bi-ṭirāz al-īqān wa-shahida bi-mā shahida Allāh wa-naṭaqa bi-mā nazala fī lawḥ al-maḥfūẓ. Nashhadu annahu mā tawaqqafa fī hādhā al-amr wa-idhā samiʿa al-nidāʾ min shaṭr rabbihi Mālik al-asmāʾ qāla labbayka labbayka yā Ilāh al-ghayb wa-l-shuhūd. Qad samiʿa wa-ajāba wa-khaḍaʿa idh atāhu al-amr min mashriq waḥy rabbihi Mālik al-wujūd. Innā zayyannā samāʾ qalbihi bi-nayyir ḥubbī al-ʿazīz al-maḥbūb. Qad fāza bi-l-raḥīq al-aṭhar idh kāna al-ʿIrāq manẓarī al-akbar. Akhadha wa-shariba bi-ismī al-mubārak al-ʿazīz al-mamnūʿ. Marratan fāza fī al-ʿIrāq wa-ukhrā idh akhrajanā al-ghāfilūn min Arḍ al-Sirr. Kadhālika yanṭiqu Jamāl al-Qidam amāma wajh al-ʿālam wa-lākinna al-umam aktharuhum lā yafqahūn.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Ghulām! The Lord of humanity remembers you and reminds you of when you were in His presence, standing at a door opened by the finger of power to all who are in the heavens and on earth. Thus has the Ancient Beauty spoken in this exalted station. Look, then recall when you heard the call of your Lord and He spoke with you with compassion and loving care. Your Lord is indeed the Almighty, the All-Loving. We also remember your father, who attained the adornment of certitude, testified to what God testified, and spoke what was sent down in the Preserved Tablet. We testify that he did not hesitate in this Cause, and when he heard the call from the direction of his Lord, the Sovereign of Names, he said, “Here I am! Here I am, O God of the unseen and the seen!” He heard, answered, and bowed in submission when the command came to him from the Dayspring of the revelation of his Lord, the Sovereign of existence. We adorned the heaven of his heart with the radiant orb of My mighty and beloved love. He attained the purest wine when Iraq was My Most Great Scene. He took it and drank in My blessed, mighty, inviolable name. Once he attained in Iraq, and another time when the heedless expelled Us from the Land of Mystery. Thus speaks the Ancient Beauty before the face of the world, yet most of its peoples do not understand.
:::

### 49

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا ذبیح یذکرک مولاک بما ورد علیک فی هذا السّبیل الّذی یطوفه الدّلیل بما نسب الی اللّه العلیم الخبیر اشهد انّک آمنت باللّه اذ ظهر بالحقّ و ما منعتک حجاب العلوم و لا ظنون الّذین کفروا باللّه ربّ العالمین قد نبذت ما عند النّاس و اخذت ما عند اللّه ربّک و ربّ العرش العظیم و اعرضت عن القوم مقبلاً الی اسمی القیّوم و ترکت الشّئونات شوقاً للقآء اللّه العزیز الحمید انت الّذی ما خوّفک عوی الذّیاب و لا قباع الّذین اعرضوا عن الحقّ متمسّکین بأوهامهم الا انّهم فی خسران مبین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Dhabīḥ, yadhkuruka mawlāka bi-mā warada ʿalayka fī hādhā al-sabīl alladhī yaṭūfuhu al-dalīl bi-mā nusiba ilā Allāh al-ʿAlīm al-Khabīr. Ashhadu annaka āmanta bi-Allāh idh ẓahara bi-l-ḥaqq wa-mā manaʿatka ḥijāb al-ʿulūm wa-lā ẓunūn alladhīna kafarū bi-Allāh Rabb al-ʿālamīn. Qad nabadhta mā ʿinda al-nās wa-akhadhta mā ʿinda Allāh rabbika wa-Rabb al-ʿarsh al-ʿaẓīm wa-aʿraḍta ʿan al-qawm muqbilan ilā ismī al-Qayyūm wa-tarakta al-shuʾūnāt shawqan li-liqāʾ Allāh al-ʿAzīz al-Ḥamīd. Anta alladhī mā khawwafaka ʿawī al-dhiʾāb wa-lā qubāʿ alladhīna aʿraḍū ʿan al-Ḥaqq mutamassikīn bi-awhāmihim. Alā innahum fī khusrān mubīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Dhabīḥ! Your Lord remembers you for what befell you in this path, around which the guide circles because of its association with God, the All-Knowing, the All-Aware. I testify that you believed in God when He appeared in truth, and neither the veil of learning nor the conjectures of those who disbelieved in God, the Lord of the worlds, kept you back. You cast aside what people possessed and took hold of what is with God, your Lord and the Lord of the mighty throne. You turned away from the people, turning toward My name, the Self-Subsisting, and abandoned worldly affairs out of longing to meet God, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy. You are the one whom neither the howling of wolves nor the grunting of those who turned away from the Truth, clinging to their vain imaginings, could frighten. Indeed, they are in manifest loss.
:::

### 50

::: {.original lang="fa"}
