از حقّ بخواه آن نفوس را بقطره‌ئی از دریای معرفت فائز فرماید و بنوری از انوار آفتاب حکمت منوّر دارد تا کلّ از ارادات خود مقدّس شده بارادهٴ الهی قیام نمایند و این امر را که مطلع زندگانی عالم و مشرق عمار ان است قیاس بامورات قبل ننمایند و فساد و صلاح از هم امتیاز دهند حقّ جلّ جلاله قادر است بر اینکه نفسی از امرا را مبعوث فرماید تا مطلّع شود و سائرین را آگاه نماید لسان حکمت میفرماید هر یومی را بما یوافقه عطا نمائید مقتضیات هر حین مشاهده کنید انّه یفعل الحقّ و یهدی السّبیل و الأمر للّه العزیز الجمیل
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Az Ḥaqq bekhāh ān nofūs rā be qaṭre-ī az daryā-ye maʿrefat fāʾez farmāyad va be nūrī az anvār-e āftāb-e ḥekmat monavvar dārad tā koll az erādāt-e khod moqaddas shode be erāde-ye elāhī qiyām namāyand va īn amr rā ke maṭlaʿ-e zendegānī-ye ʿālam va mashreq-e \[corrupted text\] ast qiyās be omūrāt-e qabl nanamāyand va fasād va ṣalāḥ az ham emtiyāz dehand. Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu qāder ast bar īnke nafsī az omarā rā mabʿūth farmāyad tā moṭṭaleʿ shavad va sāʾerīn rā āgāh namāyad. Lesān-e ḥekmat mīfarmāyad har yawmī rā be mā yovāfeqoh ʿaṭā namāyīd moqtażayāt-e har ḥīn moshāhede konīd. Innahu yafʿalu al-ḥaqq wa-yahdī al-sabīl wa-l-amru li-llāh al-ʿAzīz al-Jamīl.
:::

::: {.translation}
Ask the True One to grant those souls a drop from the ocean of knowledge and illumine them with a ray from the sun of wisdom, so that all may become sanctified from their own desires and act according to the divine will, neither comparing this Cause—which is the dawning-place of the world’s life and the dayspring of \[corrupted original text\]—with the affairs of the past, nor failing to distinguish corruption from rectitude. The True One, glorified be His glory, is able to raise up one of the rulers to become informed and make the others aware. The Tongue of Wisdom says: “Give each day what accords with it; consider the requirements of every moment.” He indeed does what is right and guides the way. Authority belongs to God, the Almighty, the All-Beautiful.
:::

### 107

::: {.original lang="fa"}
یا ورقآء از قبل گفته‌ام لا تصدّقوا کلّ قائل و لا تطمئنّوا من کلّ وارد و امثال آن مع‌ذلک بعضی از دوستان بمجرّد ادّعاء نفسی قبول مینمایند و او را محرم میشمرند و این خطا بوده و خواهد بود اگرچه الحمد للّه محافل و مجالس و اجماع احبّاء مقدّس و منزّه است از فتنه و فساد ولکن اطّلاع بر جمعیّت و آمد و شد دوستان الهی امری است مهیّج افئده و افکار غافلین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Warqāʾ az qabl gofte-am lā tuṣaddiqū kulla qāʾil wa-lā taṭmaʾinnū min kulli wārid va amthāl-e ān. Maʿa dhālek baʿżī az dūstān be mojarrad-e eddeʿā-ye nafsī qabūl mīnamāyand va ū rā maḥram mīshemorand va īn khaṭā būde va khāhad būd. Agarche al-ḥamdu li-llāh maḥāfel va majāles va ejtemāʿ-e aḥebbā moqaddas va monazzah ast az fetne va fasād va-līkan eṭṭelāʿ bar jamʿiyyat va āmad va shod-e dūstān-e elāhī amrī ast mohayyej-e afʾede va afkār-e ghāfelīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Varqā! I have said before: “Do not believe everyone who speaks, nor place your trust in everyone who arrives,” and other such admonitions. Nevertheless, some of the friends accept a person merely on the strength of a claim and regard that person as a confidant. This has been, and will remain, a mistake. Although, praise be to God, the assemblies, meetings, and gatherings of the loved ones are sanctified and free from sedition and disorder, knowledge of the gatherings and the coming and going of the friends of God stirs the hearts and minds of the heedless.
:::

### 108

::: {.original lang="ar"}
چون از اصل امر مطّلع نیستند لذا از این امور مضطرب میشوند و در اطفای نور الهی بقدر قوّه کوشش مینمایند اگرچه قادر نبوده و نیستند کذلک القینا علیک ما یحکی عن فضلی و رحمتی و عنایتی و شفقتی و مواهبی لتشکر ربّک المشفق الکریم انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Chon az aṣl-e amr moṭṭaleʿ nīstand ledhā az īn omūr możṭareb mīshavand va dar eṭfā-ye nūr-e elāhī be qadr-e qovve kūshesh mīnamāyand agarche qāder nabūde va nīstand. Kadhālika alqaynā ʿalayka mā yaḥkī ʿan faḍlī wa-raḥmatī wa-ʿināyatī wa-shafaqatī wa-mawāhibī li-tashkura rabbaka al-Mushfiq al-Karīm. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
Since they are unaware of the true nature of the Cause, these things make them anxious, and they strive with all their might to extinguish the divine light, although they have never been able to do so and remain unable. Thus have We imparted to you that which tells of My grace, My mercy, My loving care, My compassion, and My gifts, so that you may thank your Lord, the Compassionate, the All-Bountiful. End.
:::

### 109

::: {.original lang="fa"}
انشآءاللّه این امور بتوجّه آن محبوب در آن اراضی بطراز اصلاح مزیّن شود در حفظ الواح الهی سعی بلیغ لازم و جهد منیع واجب و هم‌چنین در ستر رسائل و الواح که از ساحت اقدس باطراف میرود باید بقدر قوّه اهتمام نمود چه اگر ضعیفی و یا منافقی اطّلاع یابد و ذکر نماید شاید ضرر آن بساحت اقدس راجع شود و یا باولیای حقّ در اطراف در هر حال ستر و کتمان این امور لازم و از حزم شمرده میشود انشآءاللّه آن محبوب از عنایت محبوب عالمیان موفّق و مؤیّدند بر خدمت امر انّه ولیّ المخلصین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
In shāʾ Allāh īn omūr be tavajjoh-e ān maḥbūb dar ān arāżī be ṭerāz-e eṣlāḥ mozayyan shavad. Dar ḥefẓ-e alvāḥ-e elāhī saʿy-e balīgh lāzem va jahd-e manīʿ vājeb va hamchenīn dar satr-e rasāʾel va alvāḥ ke az sāḥat-e aqdas be aṭrāf mīravad bāyad be qadr-e qovve ehtemām namūd, che agar żaʿīfī va yā monāfeqī eṭṭelāʿ yābad va dhekr namāyad shāyad żarar-e ān be sāḥat-e aqdas rājeʿ shavad va yā be awliyā-ye Ḥaqq dar aṭrāf. Dar har ḥāl satr va ketmān-e īn omūr lāzem va az ḥazm shemorde mīshavad. In shāʾ Allāh ān maḥbūb az ʿenāyat-e Maḥbūb-e ʿālamiyān movaffaq va moʾayyadand bar khedmat-e amr. Innahu waliyy al-mukhliṣīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
God willing, through the attention of that loved one, these matters will be set right in those regions. Great care and earnest effort are required to safeguard the divine Tablets. Likewise, every possible effort must be made to keep concealed the letters and Tablets sent from the Most Holy Court to various places, for if a weak or hypocritical person learns of them and speaks of them, the resulting harm may reach the Most Holy Court or the loved ones of the True One elsewhere. In all circumstances, keeping these matters hidden and confidential is necessary and is considered prudent. God willing, through the grace of the Beloved of all the worlds, that loved one will be assisted and confirmed in service to the Cause. He is indeed the Guardian of the sincere.
:::

### 110

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه در فقرهٴ تأویل که در کتاب اقدس از قلم اعلی نازل شده سؤال \[نمودید\] در ساحت امنع اقدس عرض شد هذا ما نطق به لسان العظمة
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnke dar feqre-ye taʾvīl ke dar Ketāb-e Aqdas az Qalam-e Aʿlā nāzel shode soʾāl \[namūdīd\] dar sāḥat-e amnaʿ-e aqdas ʿarż shod. Hādhā mā naṭaqa bihi lisān al-ʿaẓama:
:::

::: {.translation}
Your question concerning the passage on interpretation revealed by the Most Exalted Pen in the Most Holy Book was presented in the most inaccessible, most holy presence. This is what the Tongue of Grandeur uttered:
:::

### 111

::: {.original lang="fa"}
مقصود از تأویل اینکه از ظاهر خود را محروم ننمایند و از مقصود محتجب نمانند مثلاً اگر از سماء مشیّت فاغسلوا وجوهکم نازل شود تأویل ننمایند که مقصود از غسل غسل وجه باطن است و باید بآب عرفان او را غسل داد و طاهر نمود و امثال آن بسا میشود نفسی باین تأویلات وجهش با کمال ذفر و وسخ آلوده میماند و بخیال خود باصل امر اللّه عمل نموده و حال اینکه در این مقام واضح و معلوم است که شستن روست بآب ظاهر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Maqṣūd az taʾvīl īnke az ẓāher khod rā maḥrūm nanamāyand va az maqṣūd moḥtajeb namānand. Mathalan agar az samā-ye mashiyyat fa-ghsilū wujūhakum nāzel shavad taʾvīl nanamāyand ke maqṣūd az ghosl ghosl-e vajh-e bāṭen ast va bāyad be āb-e ʿerfān ū rā ghosl dād va ṭāher namūd va amthāl-e ān. Basā mīshavad nafsī be īn taʾvīlāt vajhash bā kamāl-e dhafar va vasakh ālūde mīmānad va be khiyāl-e khod be aṣl-e amr Allāh ʿamal namūde va ḥāl ānke dar īn maqām vāżeḥ va maʿlūm ast ke shostan-e rūst be āb-e ẓāher.
:::

::: {.translation}
What is meant concerning interpretation is that people should not deprive themselves of the outward meaning or remain veiled from the intended meaning. For example, if “Wash your faces” descends from the heaven of the divine will, they should not interpret it to mean that washing signifies washing the inner face, which must be washed and purified with the water of spiritual knowledge, and so forth. It often happens that, through such interpretations, a person’s face remains thoroughly foul-smelling and dirty, while that person imagines they have carried out the very essence of God’s command. Yet it is clear and evident that what is meant here is washing the face with physical water.
:::

### 112

::: {.original lang="fa"}
بعض کلمات الهی را میتوان تأویل نمود یعنی تأویلاتی که سبب و علّت ظنون و اوهام نشود و از مقصود الهی محروم نماند در ما انزله الرّحمن فی الفرقان تفکّر نما قوله تعالی و من یؤت الحکمة فقد اوتی خیراً کثیراً بعضی برآنند که مقصود از این حکمت احکام الهیّه است که در کتاب نازل و برخی برآنند که این حکمت علم طبّ است و هر نفسی بآن فائز شد بخیر کثیر فائز است چه که این متعلّق بانسان است و علم ابدان و این علم اشرف از سایر علوم است چنانچه از قبل لسان حکمت باینکلمهٴ علیا نطق نموده العلم علمان علم الأبدان و علم الأدیان علم ابدان را در کلمهٴ مبارکه مقدّم داشته و فی الحقیقه مقدّم است چه که ظهور حقّ و احکام الهی جمیع از برای تربیت انسان و ترقّی او و حفظ اهل عالم و امثال آن بوده و خواهد بود لذا آنچه سبب و علّت حفظ و صحّت و سلامتی وجود انسان است مقدّم بوده و خواهد بود
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Baʿż-e kalemāt-e elāhī rā mītavān taʾvīl namūd yaʿnī taʾvīlātī ke sabab va ʿellat-e ẓonūn va owhām nashavad va az maqṣūd-e elāhī maḥrūm namānad. Dar mā anzalahu al-Raḥmān fī al-Furqān tafakkor namā, qawluhu taʿālā: wa-man yuʾta al-ḥikmata fa-qad ūtiya khayran kathīran. Baʿżī bar ānand ke maqṣūd az īn ḥekmat aḥkām-e elāhiyye ast ke dar ketāb nāzel va barkhī bar ānand ke īn ḥekmat ʿelm-e ṭebb ast va har nafsī be ān fāʾez shod be khayr-e kathīr fāʾez ast, che ke īn motaʿalleq be ensān ast va ʿelm-e abdān va īn ʿelm ashraf az sāyer-e ʿolūm ast. Chenānche az qabl lesān-e ḥekmat be īn kalame-ye ʿolyā noṭq namūde: al-ʿilmu ʿilmān ʿilm al-abdān wa-ʿilm al-adyān. ʿElm-e abdān rā dar kalame-ye mobārake moqaddam dāshte va fī al-ḥaqīqe moqaddam ast che ke ẓohūr-e Ḥaqq va aḥkām-e elāhī jamīʿ az barā-ye tarbiyat-e ensān va taraqqī-ye ū va ḥefẓ-e ahl-e ʿālam va amthāl-e ān būde va khāhad būd. Ledhā ānche sabab va ʿellat-e ḥefẓ va ṣeḥḥat va salāmatī-ye vojūd-e ensān ast moqaddam būde va khāhad būd.
:::

::: {.translation}
Some divine words may be interpreted—that is, through interpretations that do not give rise to conjectures and delusions or deprive one of the divine intent. Reflect on what the All-Merciful revealed in the Qur’an, exalted be His words: “Whoever is given wisdom has indeed been given abundant good.” Some hold that this wisdom means the divine laws revealed in the Book, while others hold that it is the science of medicine, and that whoever attains it has attained abundant good, since it concerns the human being and is the science of bodies, and this science is nobler than the other sciences. Thus, in the past, the tongue of wisdom uttered this exalted saying: “Knowledge is of two kinds: knowledge of bodies and knowledge of religions.” In this blessed saying, knowledge of bodies was given precedence, and in truth it has precedence, for the revelation of the True One and the divine laws have all been, and will remain, for the education and advancement of humanity, the protection of the people of the world, and similar purposes. Thus, whatever brings about the preservation, health, and well-being of the human body has had, and will continue to have, precedence.
:::

### 113

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و این فقره واضح و مشهود است و بعضی برآنند که حکمت معرفت حقایق اشیاء است که هر نفسی باینمقام فائز شود دارای مقامات عالیه خواهد بود و حزبی برآنند حکمت عمل به ما ینتفع به الانسان است هر که باینمقام موفّق شود او دارای خیر کثیر است و جمهوری برآنند که حکمت آن است که انسانرا از ما یذلّه حفظ مینماید و به ما یعزّه هدایت میکند و شرذمه‌ئی برآنند که حکمت علم معاشرت با خلق است و مدارای با عباد علی شأن لا یتجاوز حدّ الاعتدال و بعضی گفته‌اند که حکمت علم الهیّاتست که از قواعد حکمای قبل است و هم‌چنین گفته‌اند حکمت علم جواهر و اعراض است و هم‌چنین علم هیئت و امثال آن و برخی گفته‌اند حکمت علم بمعاش است در دنیا و شرذمه‌ئی قائلند بر اینکه حکمت علم باصول است و نفوسی برآنند که حکمت در شئونات عدل است و آن اعطاء کلّ ذی حقّ حقّه بوده و خواهد بود و برخی برآنند که علم اکسیر است هر نفسی بآن فائز شد بخیر کثیر فائز است و بعضی برآنند که علم هندسه و امثال آن است و هر حزبی هم بقدر ادراک خود برهان و دلیل از برای هر یک از آنچه ذکر شد گفته‌اند که اگر بتفصیل این مقامات ذکر شود بر کسالت بیفزاید سبحان من نطق بهذه الکلمة العلیا رأس الحکمة مخافة اللّه چه مخافة اللّه و خشیته انسانرا منع مینماید از آنچه سبب ذلّت و پستی مقام انسان است و تأیید مینماید او را بر آنچه سبب علوّ و سموّ است انسان عاقل از اعمال شنیعه اجتناب مینماید چه که مجازات را از پی مشاهده میکند خیمهٴ نظم عالم بدو ستون قائم و برپا مکافات و مجازات چندی قبل این آیهٴ مبارکه از مشرق فم الهی اشراق نمود للعدل جند و هی مجازات الأعمال و مکافاتها و بهما ارتفع خبآء النّظم فی العالم و اخذ کلّ طاغ زمام نفسه من خشیة الجزآء کذلک نطق مالک الأسمآء انّه لهو النّاطق العلیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īn faqara vāżeḥ va mashhūd ast va baʿżī bar ānand ke ḥekmat maʿrefat-e ḥaqāyeq-e ashyāʾ ast ke har nafsī be īn maqām fāʾez shavad dārā-ye maqāmāt-e ʿāliya khvāhad būd va ḥezbī bar ānand ḥekmat ʿamal be mā yantafiʿu bihi al-insān ast har ke be īn maqām movaffaq shavad ū dārā-ye khayr-e kathīr ast va jomhūrī bar ānand ke ḥekmat ān ast ke ensān rā az mā yudhilluhu ḥefẓ mīnamāyad va be mā yuʿizzuhu hedāyat mīkonad va sherdhemaʾī bar ānand ke ḥekmat ʿelm-e moʿāsherat bā khalq ast va modārā-ye bā ʿebād ʿalā shaʾnin lā yata jāwazu ḥadda al-iʿtidāl va baʿżī gofteʾand ke ḥekmat ʿelm-e elāhīyāt ast ke az qavāʿed-e ḥokamā-ye qabl ast va hamchenīn gofteʾand ḥekmat ʿelm-e javāher va aʿrāż ast va hamchenīn ʿelm-e heyʾat va amthāl-e ān va barkhī gofteʾand ḥekmat ʿelm be maʿāsh ast dar donyā va sherdhemaʾī qāʾeland bar īnke ḥekmat ʿelm be oṣūl ast va nofūsī bar ānand ke ḥekmat dar shoʾūnāt-e ʿadl ast va ān iʿṭāʾu kulli dhī ḥaqqin ḥaqqahu būde va khvāhad būd va barkhī bar ānand ke ʿelm-e eksīr ast har nafsī be ān fāʾez shod be khayr-e kathīr fāʾez ast va baʿżī bar ānand ke ʿelm-e hendesa va amthāl-e ān ast va har ḥezbī ham be qadr-e edrāk-e khvod borhān va dalīl az barā-ye har yek az ānche dhekr shod gofteʾand ke agar be tafṣīl īn maqāmāt dhekr shavad bar kesālat bīafzāyad subḥāna man naṭaqa bi-hādhihi al-kalimati al-ʿulyā raʾsu al-ḥikmati makhāfatu Allāh che makhāfat Allāh va khashyatahu ensān rā manʿ mīnamāyad az ānche sabab-e dhellat va pastī-ye maqām-e ensān ast va taʾyīd mīnamāyad ū rā bar ānche sabab-e ʿolovv va somovv ast ensān-e ʿāqel az aʿmāl-e shanīʿa ejtenāb mīnamāyad che ke mojāzāt rā az pey moshāheda mīkonad kheyma-ye naẓm-e ʿālam be do sotūn qāʾem va barpā mokāfāt va mojāzāt chandī qabl īn āya-ye mobāraka az mashreq-e fam-e elāhī eshrāq namūd li-l-ʿadli jundun wa-hiya mujāzātu al-aʿmāli wa-mukāfaʾātuhā wa-bihimā irtafaʿa khibāʾu al-naẓmi fī al-ʿālami wa-akhadha kullu ṭāghin zimāma nafsihi min khashyati al-jazāʾ kadhālika naṭaqa māliku al-asmāʾ innahu la-huwa al-nāṭiqu al-ʿalīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
This matter is clear and evident. Some hold that wisdom is knowledge of the realities of things, and that whoever attains this station will possess exalted stations. Another group holds that wisdom is acting upon what benefits humanity: whoever succeeds in attaining this station possesses abundant good. A great many hold that wisdom is what protects a person from whatever abases them and guides them to whatever exalts them. A small group holds that wisdom is the knowledge of how to associate with people and treat God’s servants with forbearance, without exceeding the bounds of moderation. Some have said that wisdom is the science of theology, which is among the established disciplines of earlier philosophers. They have also said that wisdom is the knowledge of substances and accidents, as well as astronomy and similar sciences. Others have said that wisdom is the knowledge of how to earn a livelihood in this world. A small group maintains that wisdom is knowledge of first principles. Some hold that wisdom consists in the manifestations of justice, which has always meant, and will continue to mean, giving everyone their due. Others hold that it is the science of the elixir: whoever attains it has attained abundant good. Some hold that it is geometry and similar sciences. Each group, according to its own understanding, has also offered proofs and arguments for each of the views mentioned. Were these matters to be set out in detail, it would only increase weariness. Glorified be He who uttered this exalted saying: “The beginning of wisdom is the fear of God.” For the fear and awe of God restrain a person from whatever brings abasement and degradation to the human station, and strengthen them in whatever brings exaltation and elevation. A wise person avoids shameful deeds, for they see the punishment that follows them. The tent of order in the world stands firmly upon two pillars: reward and punishment. Some time ago, this blessed verse shone forth from the dawning-place of the divine mouth: “Justice has a host, namely the punishment of deeds and their reward. Through these two, the tent of order has been raised in the world, and every transgressor has taken hold of the reins of his own self for fear of retribution. Thus has the Lord of Names spoken. He is indeed the Speaker, the All-Knowing.”
:::

### 114

::: {.original lang="fa"}
از قبل بعضی نفوس خود را اهل طریقت نامیده‌اند چنانچه آثار آن نفوس حال در ارض موجود است طوائف مختلفه هر یک طریقی اخذ کرده‌اند اسلام از آن نفوس متفرّق شد و از بحر اعظم خلیجها خارج نمودند تا آنکه بالأخره بر دین اللّه وارد شد آنچه وارد شد اسلام با آن قوّت عظیمه از اعمال و افعال منتسبین او بکمال ضعف مبدّل شد چنانچه مشاهده نموده و مینمایند بعضی از نفوس که خود را دراویش مینامند جمیع احکام و اوامر الهی را تأویل نمودند اگر گفته شود صلوة از احکام محکمهٴ الهی است میگویند صلوة بمعنی دعا است و ما در حین تولّد بدعا آمده‌ایم و صلوة حقیقی را عمل نموده‌ایم و این بیچاره از ظاهر محروم است تا چه رسد بباطن اوهامات نفوس غافله زیاده از حدّ احصا بوده و هست
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Az qabl baʿżī nofūs khvod rā ahl-e ṭarīqat nāmīdeʾand chenānche āthār-e ān nofūs ḥāl dar arż mowjūd ast ṭavāʾef-e mokhtalefa har yek ṭarīqī akhdh kardeʾand eslām az ān nofūs motafarreq shod va az baḥr-e aʿẓam khalījhā khārej namūdand tā ānke bi-l-ākhara bar dīn Allāh vāred shod ānche vāred shod eslām bā ān qovvat-e ʿaẓīma az aʿmāl va afʿāl-e montasebīn-e ū be kamāl-e żaʿf mobaddal shod chenānche moshāheda namūde va mīnamāyand baʿżī az nofūs ke khvod rā darāvīsh mīnāmand jamīʿ-e aḥkām va avāmer-e elāhī rā taʾvīl namūdand agar gofte shavad ṣalāt az aḥkām-e moḥkama-ye elāhī ast mīgūyand ṣalāt be maʿnī-ye doʿā ast va mā dar ḥīn-e tavallod be doʿā āmadeʾīm va ṣalāt-e ḥaqīqī rā ʿamal namūdeʾīm va īn bīchāra az ẓāher maḥrūm ast tā che rasad be bāṭen owhāmāt-e nofūs-e ghāfela ziyāda az ḥadd-e eḥṣā būde va hast.
:::

::: {.translation}
In the past, some people called themselves followers of the mystical path, and their works still exist in the world today. Various sects each adopted a different path. Through these people, Islam became divided, and they drew channels away from the Most Great Ocean, until at last there befell the religion of God what befell it. Islam, with all its immense power, was reduced to utter weakness through the deeds and actions of those who claimed allegiance to it, as people have witnessed and continue to witness. Some who call themselves dervishes have interpreted away all the divine laws and commandments. If they are told that obligatory prayer is one of God’s firmly established laws, they say, “Obligatory prayer means supplication, and at birth we came into the world supplicating, and have thus performed the true obligatory prayer.” Yet this hapless person is deprived of the outward observance, let alone the inward reality. The delusions of heedless souls have always been, and remain, beyond reckoning.
:::

### 115

::: {.original lang="fa"}
باری از تنبلی و کسالت جمیع اوامر الهی را که بمثابهٴ سدّ محکم است از برای حفظ عالم و امنیّت آن تأویل نمودند و در تکایا انزوا جسته جز خورد و خواب شغلی اختیار ننموده‌اند و در معارف آنچه گفته شود تصدیق مینمایند ولکن اثر حرارت محبّة اللّه تا حال از ایشان دیده نشد مگر معدود قلیلی که حلاوت بیانرا یافتند و فی‌الجمله بر مقصود از ظهور آگاه گشتند بعضی از این تأویلات که در بیان حکمت ذکر شد هر یک در مقام خود صحیح است چه با اصول احکام الهی مخالف نیست آیاتیکه در اوامر و نواهی الهی است مثل عبادات و دیات و جنایات و امثال آن مقصود عمل بظاهر آیات بوده و خواهد بود
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bārī az tanbalī va kesālat jamīʿ-e avāmer-e elāhī rā ke be mathāba-ye sadd-e moḥkam ast az barā-ye ḥefẓ-e ʿālam va amnīyat-e ān taʾvīl namūdand va dar takāyā enzevā joste joz khvord va khvāb shoghlī ekhtiyār nanamūdeʾand va dar maʿāref ānche gofte shavad taṣdīq mīnamāyand va lāken athar-e ḥarārat-e maḥabbat Allāh tā ḥāl az īshān dīde nashod magar maʿdūd-e qalīlī ke ḥalāvat-e bayān rā yāftand va fī al-jomla bar maqṣūd az ẓohūr āgāh gashtand baʿżī az īn taʾvīlāt ke dar bayān-e ḥekmat dhekr shod har yek dar maqām-e khvod ṣaḥīḥ ast che bā oṣūl-e aḥkām-e elāhī mokhālef nīst āyātī ke dar avāmer va navāhī-ye elāhī ast methl-e ʿebādāt va diyāt va jenāyāt va amthāl-e ān maqṣūd ʿamal be ẓāher-e āyāt būde va khvāhad būd.
:::

::: {.translation}
In short, out of laziness and indolence, they have interpreted away all the divine commandments, which are like a mighty barrier for the protection and security of the world. Secluding themselves in dervish lodges, they have adopted no occupation but eating and sleeping. In matters of spiritual knowledge, they assent to whatever is said, yet no trace of the warmth of the love of God has so far been seen in them, except for a very few who have tasted the sweetness of the utterance and have gained some awareness of the purpose of the Revelation. Some of the interpretations mentioned in the discussion of wisdom are each valid in their own context, for they do not conflict with the principles of the divine laws. As for verses concerning divine commandments and prohibitions, such as acts of worship, blood money, criminal offenses, and the like, the intention has always been, and will remain, that the outward meaning of the verses be put into practice.
:::

### 116

::: {.original lang="fa"}
ولکن آیات الهی که در ذکر قیامت و ساعت چه در کتب قبل چه در فرقان نازل شده اکثر مأوّل است و لا یعلم تأویله الّا اللّه این مراتب در کتاب ایقان واضح و مبرهن است هر نفسی در آن تفکّر نماید آگاه شود بر آنچه از نظر کلّ مستور بوده انظر فیما انزله الوهّاب فی الکتاب قوله تعالی لا الشّمس ینبغی لها ان تدرک القمر و لا اللّیل سابق النّهار این آیهٴ مبارکه را علما از قبل و بعد تفسیر و تأویل نموده‌اند و هر یک باعتقاد خود معنی آن را یافته‌اند و لکن این مقام العلم و این مراتب الظّنون و الأوهام نفسیکه او را سلطان المفسّرین مینامند یعنی قاضی بیضاوی گفته این آیه رداً لعبدة الشّمس نازل گشته مشاهده نمائید چه مقدار بعید است از منبع علم مع تبحّره علی زعم النّاس زمام علوم در قبضهٴ قدرت الهی است عطا میفرماید بهر که اراده نماید
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va lāken āyāt-e elāhī ke dar dhekr-e qiyāmat va sāʿat che dar kotob-e qabl che dar Forqān nāzel shode akthar moʾavval ast wa-lā yaʿlamu taʾwīlahu illā Allāh īn marāteb dar Ketāb-e Īqān vāżeḥ va mobarhan ast har nafsī dar ān tafakkor namāyad āgāh shavad bar ānche az naẓar-e koll mastūr būde unẓur fīmā anzalahu al-Wahhābu fī al-kitāb qawluhu taʿālā lā al-shamsu yanbaghī lahā an tudrika al-qamara wa-lā al-laylu sābiqu al-nahār īn āya-ye mobāraka rā ʿolamā az qabl va baʿd tafsīr va taʾvīl namūdeʾand va har yek be eʿteqād-e khvod maʿnī-ye ān rā yāfteʾand va lāken ayna maqāmu al-ʿilm wa-ayna marātibu al-ẓunūni wa-al-awhām nafsī ke ū rā solṭān al-mofasserīn mīnāmand yaʿnī Qāżī Beyżāvī gofte īn āya raddan li-ʿabadati al-shams nāzel gashte moshāheda namāʾīd che meqdār baʿīd ast az manbaʿ-e ʿelm maʿa tabaḥḥurihi ʿalā zaʿmi al-nās zemām-e ʿolūm dar qabża-ye qodrat-e elāhī ast ʿaṭā mīfarmāyad be har ke erāda namāyad.
:::

::: {.translation}
However, most of the divine verses revealed concerning the Resurrection and the Hour, whether in the earlier scriptures or in the Qur’an, are subject to interpretation: “None knows its interpretation but God.” These matters are clear and demonstrated in the Book of Certitude. Whoever reflects upon it will become aware of what has been hidden from everyone’s sight. Consider what the All-Bountiful has revealed in the Book, exalted be His words: “It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor does the night outstrip the day.” Scholars, both earlier and later, have explained and interpreted this blessed verse, and each believes that he has grasped its meaning. But how far the station of knowledge is from the levels of conjecture and delusion! The man they call the sovereign of commentators, namely Qāḍī Bayḍāwī, has said that this verse was revealed as a refutation of sun worshippers. Observe how far he is from the source of knowledge, despite his vast learning in the estimation of the people. The reins of the sciences are held in the grasp of divine power. He bestows them upon whomever He wills.
:::

### 117

::: {.original lang="fa"}
در کتب قبل هم آنچه در ذکر این ظهور از قلم اعلی جاری شد اکثر مأوّل است مثلاً میفرماید تذوب الودیان کالشّمع قدّام الرّبّ و هم‌چنین میفرماید خیمهٴ او بر جبال مرتفع میشود چنانچه شده و در مقامی دیگر میفرماید خیمه‌ایست از برای او که طنابهای او بریده نشده و نمیشود میخهایش کنده نشده و نمیشود و از جائی بجائی نقل نمیشود این فقرات مأوّل است انسان منصف ادراک مینماید که چه مقام مقام تأویل است و چه مقام حکم بر ظاهر تنزیل
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dar kotob-e qabl ham ānche dar dhekr-e īn ẓohūr az qalam-e aʿlā jārī shod akthar moʾavval ast mathalan mīfarmāyad tadhūbu al-widyānu ka-al-shamʿi quddāma al-rabb va hamchenīn mīfarmāyad kheyma-ye ū bar jebāl mortafeʿ mīshavad chenānche shode va dar maqāmī dīgar mīfarmāyad kheymaʾīst az barā-ye ū ke ṭanābhā-ye ū borīde nashode va namīshavad mīkhhāyash kande nashode va namīshavad va az jāʾī be jāʾī naql namīshavad īn faqarāt moʾavval ast ensān-e monṣef edrāk mīnamāyad ke che maqām maqām-e taʾvīl ast va che maqām ḥokm bar ẓāher-e tanzīl.
:::

::: {.translation}
Likewise, in the earlier scriptures, most of what flowed from the Most Exalted Pen concerning this Revelation is subject to interpretation. For example, He says, “The valleys melt like wax before the Lord.” He also says, “His tent will be raised upon the mountains,” as has indeed happened. Elsewhere He says, “He has a tent whose cords have not been, and will not be, cut, whose pegs have not been, and will not be, uprooted, and which will not be moved from place to place.” These passages are subject to interpretation. A fair-minded person understands where interpretation is called for and where the outward meaning of the revealed text is binding.
:::

### 118

::: {.original lang="ar"}
باری الیوم آنچه ناس را از آلایش پاک نماید و بآسایش حقیقی رساند آن مذهب اللّه و دین اللّه و امر اللّه بوده کذلک انهمر غیث البیان من سمآء العرفان فضلاً علیک اشکر و قل لک الحمد یا محبوب العارفین و لک الثّنآء یا مقصود العالمین و لک الشّکر یا من فی قبضتک ملکوت ملک السّموات و الأرضین انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bārī al-yowm ānche nās rā az ālāyesh pāk namāyad va be āsāyesh-e ḥaqīqī rasānad ān madhhab Allāh va dīn Allāh va amr Allāh būde kadhālika inhamara ghaythu al-bayāni min samāʾi al-ʿirfāni faḍlan ʿalayka ushkur wa-qul laka al-ḥamdu yā maḥbūba al-ʿārifīn wa-laka al-thanāʾu yā maqṣūda al-ʿālamīn wa-laka al-shukru yā man fī qabḍatika malakūtu mulki al-samāwāti wa-al-araḍīn intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
In short, today, whatever cleanses people of defilement and brings them true peace is the way of God, the religion of God, and the Cause of God. Thus has the rain of utterance poured down from the heaven of divine knowledge as a bounty to you. Give thanks and say, “Praise be to You, O Beloved of those who know You! To You be all acclaim, O Desire of the worlds! To You be thanks, O You in whose grasp is the dominion of the kingdom of the heavens and the earth!” End.
:::

### 119

::: {.original lang="fa"}
از آنچه از ملکوت بیان رحمن نازل معلوم و واضح است که بعضی از آیات الهیّه که در معاشرت و آداب و سلوک و معاملات و حدودات و امثال آن نازل اگر حکم از ظاهر آن خارج شود امر اللّه معطّل و معوّق ماند یشهد بذلک کلّ عالم بصیر از حقّ بطلبید اهل عالم را بطراز انصاف مزیّن فرماید بامورات جزئیه و خارق عادات محدوده و آیات معدوده اظهار ایمان مینمایند و از دریاهای آن معرض مشاهده میشوند انسان متحیّر است جلّ من ستر عنهم و کشف لنا
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Az ānche az malakūt-e bayān-e Raḥmān nāzel maʿlūm va vāżeḥ ast ke baʿżī az āyāt-e elāhīya ke dar moʿāsherat va ādāb va solūk va moʿāmelāt va ḥodūdāt va amthāl-e ān nāzel agar ḥokm az ẓāher-e ān khārej shavad amr Allāh moʿaṭṭal va moʿavvaq mānad yashhadu bi-dhālika kullu ʿālimin baṣīr az Ḥaqq beṭalabīd ahl-e ʿālam rā be ṭerāz-e enṣāf mozayyan farmāyad be omūrāt-e jozʾīya va khāreq-e ʿādāt-e maḥdūda va āyāt-e maʿdūda eẓhār-e īmān mīnamāyand va az daryāhā-ye ān moʿreż moshāheda mīshavand ensān motaḥayyer ast jalla man satara ʿanhum wa-kashafa lanā.
:::

::: {.translation}
From what has been revealed from the kingdom of the All-Merciful’s utterance, it is clear and evident that, in the case of certain divine verses revealed concerning social relations, manners, conduct, transactions, legal penalties, and the like, if their rulings are removed from their outward meaning, the Cause of God will be brought to a standstill and hindered. Every discerning scholar bears witness to this. Beseech the True One to adorn the people of the world with the ornament of fairness. They profess faith on the basis of trifling matters, a limited number of extraordinary occurrences, and a handful of signs, yet are seen to turn away from oceans of them. One is bewildered. Exalted be He who has concealed from them and disclosed to us.
:::

### 120

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه از ماء بکر و حدّ مستعمل آن را سؤال نمودید تلقاء عرش عرض شد هذا ما نطق به اللّه آب قلیل مثل یک کأس یا دو مقابل یا سه مقابل آن دست و رو در آن شستن از مستعمل مذکور ولکن اگر بحدّ کر برسد از تغسیل یک وجه یا دو وجه تغییر نمینماید و در استعمال آن بأسی نبوده و نیست و اگر یکی از اوصاف ثلاثه در او ظاهر شود یعنی فی‌الجمله لون آب تغییر نماید از مستعمل محسوب است یا ایّها الشّارب عن کأس عنایتی مقصود لطافت است از حوضهای \[عجم\] مطّلعید هر قدر همّت بر لطافت مصروف شود عنداللّه محبوب است انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnke az māʾ-e bekr va ḥadd-e mostaʿmal-e ān rā soʾāl namūdīd telqāʾ-e ʿarsh ʿarż shod hādhā mā naṭaqa bihi Allāh āb-e qalīl methl-e yek kās yā do moqābel yā se moqābel-e ān dast va rū dar ān shostan az mostaʿmal madhkūr va lāken agar be ḥadd-e korr beresad az taghsīl-e yek vajh yā do vajh taghyīr namīnamāyad va dar esteʿmāl-e ān baʾsī nabūde va nīst va agar yekī az owṣāf-e thalātha dar ū ẓāher shavad yaʿnī fī al-jomla lown-e āb taghyīr namāyad az mostaʿmal maḥsūb ast yā ayyuhā al-shāribu ʿan kaʾsi ʿināyatī maqṣūd leṭāfat ast az ḥowżhā-ye \[ʿAjam\] moṭṭaleʿīd har qadr hemmat bar leṭāfat maṣrūf shavad ʿinda Allāh maḥbūb ast intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
Your question concerning unused water and the point at which it is considered used was submitted before the Throne. This is what God has spoken: “With a small quantity of water, such as a cupful or twice or three times that amount, washing the hands and face in it renders it used. But if it reaches the volume of a kurr, washing one or two faces does not alter it, and there has been and is no objection to using it. If one of the three properties appears in it—that is, if the color of the water changes to some degree—it is considered used. O you who drink from the cup of My loving care! The purpose is cleanliness. You are familiar with the pools of \[Persia\]. However much effort is devoted to cleanliness is pleasing in the sight of God.” End.
:::

### 121

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و اینکه در بارهٴ ذکر مرقوم داشتید که بعضی از دوستان الهی قبل از طلوع برمیخیزند و بذکر حقّ جلّ جلاله مشغول میگردند و حال آنکه این ذکر مال یوم است و تحدید یوم در ایّام صیام من الطّلوع الی الأفول شده این فقره هم در ساحت اقدس من لا یعزب عن علمه من شیء عرض شد هذا ما نطق به الحقّ جلّ جلاله یوم فی‌الحقیقه در بیان من الطّلوع الی الأفول است ولکن نفوسیکه قبل از طلوع حبّاً للّه برمیخیزند و بذکر مشغول میشوند این لدی العرش محبوب است و مقبول دیگر اعاده لازم نه و همچنین در مشرق الأذکار دوستان الهی متمسّکین بما نزل فی کتاب الأقدس در اسحار توجّه بمشرق الأذکار مینمایند و بذکر محبوب عالمیان مشغول میشوند ایشانهم اگر در طلوع و بعد از طلوع بساعتی بذکر مشغول شوند مقبولست حقّ در جمیع احوال راحت عباد را خواسته و ذکرش اگر بتمام روح و ریحان از ذاکری ظاهر شود محبوب و مقبول بوده و خواهد بود طوبی لنفس تنفّست بحبّ مولاه و طوبی لعبد ایقظته نفحات محبّة اللّه انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va īnke dar bāra-ye dhekr marqūm dāshtīd ke baʿżī az dūstān-e elāhī qabl az ṭolūʿ barmīkhīzand va be dhekr-e Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu mashghūl mīgardand va ḥāl ānke īn dhekr māl-e yowm ast va taḥdīd-e yowm dar ayyām-e ṣiyām min al-ṭulūʿ ilā al-ufūl shode īn faqara ham dar sāḥat-e aqdas-e man lā yaʿzubu ʿan ʿilmihi min shayʾ ʿarż shod hādhā mā naṭaqa bihi al-Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu yowm fī al-ḥaqīqa dar Bayān min al-ṭulūʿ ilā al-ufūl ast va lāken nofūsī ke qabl az ṭolūʿ ḥubban li-llāh barmīkhīzand va be dhekr mashghūl mīshavand īn ladā al-ʿarsh maḥbūb ast va maqbūl dīgar eʿāda lāzem na va hamchenīn dar Mashreq al-Adhkār dūstān-e elāhī motamassekīn bi-mā nazala fī Kitāb al-Aqdas dar asḥār tavajjoh be Mashreq al-Adhkār mīnamāyand va be dhekr-e Maḥbūb-e ʿālamiyān mashghūl mīshavand īshān ham agar dar ṭolūʿ va baʿd az ṭolūʿ be sāʿatī be dhekr mashghūl shavand maqbūl ast Ḥaqq dar jamīʿ-e aḥvāl rāḥat-e ʿebād rā khvāste va dhekrash agar be tamām-e rūḥ va reyḥān az dhākerī ẓāher shavad maḥbūb va maqbūl būde va khvāhad būd ṭūbā li-nafsin tanaffasat bi-ḥubbi mawlāhā wa-ṭūbā li-ʿabdin ayqaẓat-hu nafaḥātu maḥabbati Allāh intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
Concerning remembrance, you wrote that some of the friends of God rise before sunrise and engage in remembrance of the True One, glorious is His majesty, whereas this remembrance belongs to the day, and during the days of fasting the day has been defined as extending from sunrise to sunset. This matter too was submitted in the most holy presence of Him from whose knowledge nothing is hidden. This is what the True One, glorious is His majesty, has spoken: “In the Bayān, the day is indeed from sunrise to sunset. However, when souls rise before sunrise out of love for God and engage in remembrance, this is pleasing and acceptable before the Throne; there is no need to repeat it. Likewise, in connection with the Mashriqu’l-Adhkār, the friends of God, holding fast to what has been revealed in the Most Holy Book, make their way to the Mashriqu’l-Adhkār in the hours before dawn and engage in remembrance of the Beloved of all the worlds. If they too engage in remembrance at sunrise or at an hour after sunrise, it is acceptable. In all circumstances, the True One has desired the ease of His servants, and if remembrance of Him proceeds from anyone with complete joy and radiance, it has been and will remain pleasing and acceptable. Blessed is the soul that has breathed with love for its Lord, and blessed is the servant whom the breezes of the love of God have awakened.” End.
:::

### 122

::: {.original lang="ar"}
اینکه در ذکر جناب آقا خلیل عطّار علیه بهآء اللّه و صعود اخیه مرقوم داشتید هذا ما انزله اللّه له قوله جلّ کبریائه
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īnke dar dhekr-e janāb-e Āqā Khalīl-e ʿAṭṭār ʿalayhi bahāʾu Allāh va ṣoʿūd-e akhīh marqūm dāshtīd hādhā mā anzalahu Allāhu lahu qawluhu jalla kibriyāʾuhu.
:::

::: {.translation}
Concerning what you wrote about Āqā Khalīl ʿAṭṭār, may the glory of God rest upon him, and the ascension of his brother, this is what God has revealed for him, glorious is His grandeur in His words:
:::

### 123

::: {.original lang="ar"}
بسمی الأقدم الأعظم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Bi-smī al-aqdami al-aʿẓam.
:::

::: {.translation}
In My name, the Most Ancient, the Most Great.
:::

### 124

::: {.original lang="ar"}
کتاب نزّل بالحقّ لمن اخذه جذب بیان الرّحمن و اجاب مولاه اذ اتی بأمر عظیم و ینادی یوم اللّه فیما سواه طوبی لذی سمع سمع و لذی قلب اقبل الیه بفرح مبین انّ الشّمس مع اشراقها تقبّس من نوره ولکنّ القوم اکثرهم من الغافلین قد ظهر کلّ ما کان مستوراً فی حجب الغیب و برز ما کان مسطوراً فی کتب اللّه ربّ العالمین من النّاس من وجد عرف قمیصی و سرع الی بحر عنایتی و منهم من اعرض و اعترض علی ما نزل من ملکوت بیانی البدیع کم من عالم نقض میثاق اللّه و عهده و کم من غافل سمع النّدآء من الأفق الأعلی و اقبل بقلبه الی اللّه العلیم الخبیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Kitābun nuzzila bi-l-ḥaqqi li-man akhadhahu jadhbu bayāni al-Raḥmān wa-ajāba mawlāhu idh atā bi-amrin ʿaẓīm, wa-yunādī yawmu Allāhi fīmā siwāhu. Ṭūbā li-dhī samʿin samiʿa wa-li-dhī qalbin aqbala ilayhi bi-faraḥin mubīn. Inna al-shamsa maʿa ishrāqihā taqtabisu min nūrihi wa-lākinna al-qawma aktharuhum mina al-ghāfilīn. Qad ẓahara kullu mā kāna mastūran fī ḥujubi al-ghaybi wa-baraza mā kāna masṭūran fī kutubi Allāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn. Mina al-nāsi man wajada ʿarfa qamīṣī wa-saraʿa ilā baḥri ʿināyatī wa-minhum man aʿraḍa wa-iʿtaraḍa ʿalā mā nazala min malakūti bayānī al-badīʿ. Kam min ʿālimin naqaḍa mīthāqa Allāhi wa-ʿahdahu wa-kam min ghāfilin samiʿa al-nidāʾa mina al-ufuqِ al-aʿlā wa-aqbala bi-qalbihi ilā Allāhi al-ʿalīmi al-khabīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
A Book sent down in truth for one whom the rapture of the All-Merciful’s utterance has seized, and who has answered his Lord when He came with a mighty Cause, while the Day of God calls out to all besides Him. Blessed is the one with ears who has heard, and the one with a heart who has turned to Him with manifest joy. The sun, despite its radiance, draws light from His light, yet most of the people are heedless. Everything concealed within the veils of the unseen has appeared, and what was inscribed in the Books of God, the Lord of the worlds, has come forth. Among the people are those who have caught the fragrance of My robe and hastened to the ocean of My loving care; others have turned away and objected to what has descended from the kingdom of My wondrous utterance. How many a learned man has broken God’s covenant and pledge, and how many a heedless one has heard the call from the Most Exalted Horizon and turned his heart toward God, the All-Knowing, the All-Aware.
:::

### 125

::: {.original lang="ar"}
یا خلیل انّا ذکرناک من قبل و ارسلنا الیک ما حکی عن ظهوری و اقتداری و رحمتی و شفقتی و فضلی الّذی احاط من فی السّموات و الأرضین لا تحزن عمّا ورد علیک قد فاز برفیق الأعلی من آمن باللّه مالک هذا الیوم المنیر انّا ذکرناه فضلاً من عندنا علیک و علیه و انا الفضّال الکریم طوبی له بما فاز بالاقبال اذ اعرض عنّی اکثر عبادی الّذین خلقناهم لخدمة امری المحکم المتین انّ ربّک غفر اخاک حین صعوده و طهّره عن الآثام و ادخله فی مقام عجزت من اوصافه السن العارفین انّا نکبّر من هذا المقام علی احبّائی فی هناک الّذین شربوا رحیق بیانی و فازوا بما جری من قلمی الأعلی انّ ربّک لهو الغفور الرّحیم البهآء من لدی اللّه مالک الأسمآء علیک و علی الّذین نزّلت اسمائهم فی لوحی الحفیظ انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Yā Khalīl, innā dhakarnāka min qablu wa-arsalnā ilayka mā ḥakā ʿan ẓuhūrī wa-iqtidārī wa-raḥmatī wa-shafaqatī wa-faḍlī alladhī aḥāṭa man fī al-samāwāti wa-l-araḍīn. Lā taḥzan ʿammā warada ʿalayka. Qad fāza bi-Rafīqi al-Aʿlā man āmana bi-Allāhi māliki hādhā al-yawmi al-munīr. Innā dhakarnāhu faḍlan min ʿindinā ʿalayka wa-ʿalayhi wa-anā al-faḍḍālu al-karīm. Ṭūbā lahu bi-mā fāza bi-l-iqbāli idh aʿraḍa ʿannī aktharu ʿibādī alladhīna khalaqnāhum li-khidmati amrī al-muḥkami al-matīn. Inna rabbaka ghafara akhāka ḥīna ṣuʿūdihi wa-ṭahharahu ʿani al-āthāmi wa-adkhalahu fī maqāmin ʿajazat min awṣāfihi alsunu al-ʿārifīn. Innā nukabbiru min hādhā al-maqāmi ʿalā aḥibbāʾī fī hunāka alladhīna sharibū raḥīqa bayānī wa-fāzū bi-mā jarā min qalamī al-aʿlā. Inna rabbaka la-huwa al-ghafūru al-raḥīm. Al-bahāʾu min ladā Allāhi māliki al-asmāʾi ʿalayka wa-ʿalā alladhīna nuzzilat asmāʾuhum fī lawḥī al-ḥafīẓ. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
O Khalīl, We previously remembered you and sent you what told of My manifestation, My power, My mercy, My compassion, and My grace, which has encompassed all who are in the heavens and on earth. Do not grieve over what has befallen you. He who believed in God, the Master of this luminous Day, has attained the companionship of the Most Exalted. We have remembered him as a grace from Us to you and to him, and I am the Most Bountiful, the Generous. Blessed is he for having turned toward Me when most of My servants, whom We created to serve My firm and steadfast Cause, turned away from Me. Your Lord forgave your brother at the time of his ascension, purified him of sins, and admitted him to a station that the tongues of those who know are powerless to describe. From this station We send greetings to My loved ones there who have drunk the choice wine of My utterance and attained what has flowed from My Most Exalted Pen. Your Lord is indeed the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful. May glory from God, the Lord of Names, rest upon you and upon those whose names have been sent down in My preserving Tablet. End.
:::

### 126

::: {.original lang="fa"}
الحمد للّه آفتاب کرم مشرق و بحر عنایت ظاهر و فرات بیان من غیر تعطیل جاری و ساری این فانی از حقّ سائل و آمل است که جمیع من علی الأرض را از نفحات این یوم امنع اقدس محروم نفرماید و به ما یحبّ و یرضی موفّق نماید انّه لهو المقتدر القدیر
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Al-ḥamdu li-llāh, āftāb-i karam mushriq va baḥr-i ʿināyat ẓāhir va Furāt-i bayān min ghayr-i taʿṭīl jārī va sārī. Īn fānī az Ḥaqq sāʾil va āmil ast ki jamīʿ-i man ʿalā al-arḍ rā az nafaḥāt-i īn yawm-i amnaʿ-i aqdas maḥrūm nafarmāyad va bi-mā yuḥibbu wa-yarḍā muwaffaq namāyad. Innahu la-huwa al-muqtadiru al-qadīr.
:::

::: {.translation}
Praise be to God, the sun of generosity is shining, the ocean of loving care is manifest, and the Euphrates of utterance flows and spreads without interruption. This mortal asks and hopes that God will deprive no one on earth of the fragrant breezes of this most exalted and most holy Day, and will enable everyone to do what He loves and approves. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent.
:::

### 127

::: {.original lang="fa"}
خدمت جمیع دوستان از جانب این فانی تکبیر برسانید و بگوئید این ایّام غیر ایّام است و این زمان غیر ازمنهٴ قبل و بعد جهد نمائید تا از انوار فجر الهی قسمت برید انّه لهو المقتدر علی ما یشآء لا اله الّا هو العزیز العظیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Khidmat-i jamīʿ-i dūstān az jānib-i īn fānī takbīr birasānīd va bigūʾīd īn ayyām ghayr-i ayyām ast va īn zamān ghayr-i azmina-yi qabl va baʿd. Jahd namāʾīd tā az anvār-i fajr-i ilāhī qismat barīd. Innahu la-huwa al-muqtadiru ʿalā mā yashāʾu lā ilāha illā huwa al-ʿazīzu al-ʿaẓīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
Convey greetings from this mortal to all the friends, and say: “These days are unlike other days, and this time is unlike the times before and after it. Strive to gain a share of the light of the divine dawn.” He indeed has power over whatever He wills. There is no God but Him, the Almighty, the Most Great.
:::

### 128

::: {.original lang="ar"}
البهآء علی حضرتکم و علی من معکم و علی الّذین اقبلوا بقلوب نورآء الی اللّه ربّنا و ربّکم و مقصودنا و مقصودکم و مقصود من فی السّموات و الأرضین
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Al-bahāʾu ʿalā ḥaḍratikum wa-ʿalā man maʿakum wa-ʿalā alladhīna aqbalū bi-qulūbin nawrāʾa ilā Allāhi rabbinā wa-rabbikum wa-maqṣūdinā wa-maqṣūdikum wa-maqṣūdi man fī al-samāwāti wa-l-araḍīn.
:::

::: {.translation}
May glory rest upon you, upon those with you, and upon those who have turned with radiant hearts toward God, our Lord and your Lord, our heart’s desire and your heart’s desire, and the heart’s desire of all who are in the heavens and on earth.
:::

### 129

::: {.original lang="fa"}
و بعد از اتمام مکتوب و حضور در ساحت اقدس لسان محبوب باین کلمهٴ مبارکهٴ علیا ناطق یا ورقآء علیک بهائی و رحمتی و عنایتی ذکر حکمت و معانی آن فی‌الجمله اظهار شد ولکن حکمت امروز آداب و اعمال و اقوالی است که ناس را بافق اعلی هدایت نماید من دون آنکه ضوضائی مرتفع شود و یا فتنه و فسادی ظاهر گردد انّ النّاس فی نوم عجیب و ریب مبین یعبدون الظّنون و لا یفقهون و یسرعون الی الأوهام و لا یشعرون باید بمدارا و رأفت غافلین را آگاه نمود و بدریای عنایت هدایت کرد بعضی از جهّال که بأجنحهٴ نفس و هوی طائرند و بنار بغضا مشتعل بر مراصد مترصّدند که دست آویزی بیابند و بر حقّ جلّ جلاله و اولیای او اعتراض نمایند انتهی
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Va baʿd az itmām-i maktūb va ḥuḍūr dar sāḥat-i aqdas lisān-i Maḥbūb bi-īn kalima-yi mubāraka-yi ʿulyā nāṭiq: Yā Warqāʾ, ʿalayka bahāʾī wa-raḥmatī wa-ʿināyatī. Dhikr-i ḥikmat va maʿānī-yi ān fī-l-jumla iẓhār shud va-līkin ḥikmat-i imrūz ādāb va aʿmāl va aqvālī ast ki nās rā bi-ufuq-i aʿlā hidāyat namāyad min dūn-i ānki ḍawḍāʾī murtafiʿ shavad va yā fitna va fasādī ẓāhir gardad. Inna al-nāsa fī nawmin ʿajībin wa-raybin mubīn. Yaʿbudūna al-ẓunūna wa-lā yafqahūna wa-yusriʿūna ilā al-awhāmi wa-lā yashʿurūn. Bāyad bi-mudārā va raʾfat ghāfilīn rā āgāh namūd va bi-daryā-yi ʿināyat hidāyat kard. Baʿḍī az juhhāl ki bi-ajniḥa-yi nafs va havā ṭāʾirand va bi-nār-i baghḍā mushtaʿil bar marāṣid mutaraṣṣidand ki dast-āvīzī biyāband va bar Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu va awliyā-yi ū iʿtirāḍ namāyand. Intahā.
:::

::: {.translation}
After the letter was completed and I entered the Most Holy Presence, the tongue of the Beloved spoke these exalted and blessed words: “O Warqāʾ, upon you be My glory, My mercy, and My loving care. Wisdom and its meanings have been explained to some extent. Today, however, wisdom consists of conduct, deeds, and words that guide people to the Most Exalted Horizon without raising an uproar or giving rise to turmoil and discord. The people are indeed sunk in a strange sleep and manifest doubt. They worship conjectures and do not understand; they hasten toward delusions and do not perceive. Through forbearance and compassion, the heedless must be awakened and guided to the ocean of loving care. Some of the ignorant, who fly on the wings of self and desire and burn with the fire of hatred, lie in wait at their watchposts, seeking a pretext to raise objections against God, exalted be His glory, and His loved ones.” End.
:::

### 130

::: {.original lang="fa"}
انشآءاللّه جمیع دوستان الهی بطراز حکمت مزیّن شوند و از هر یک ظاهر شود آنچه مشعر و مدلّ بر ارتفاع امر است حقّ علمای عصر را انصاف عطا فرماید و بصر عنایت نماید شاید انوار آفتاب حقیقت را که در قطب زوال منیر و روشن است مشاهده نمایند و از او محروم نمانند لازال این نفوس سبب ضلالت و گمراهی بوده و هستند الّا من شآءاللّه یسئل الخادم ربّه بأن یعرّفهم و یعلّمهم ما غفلوا عنه و یقرّبهم الیه فضلاً من عنده انّه لهو الغفور الرّحیم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
In shāʾ Allāh jamīʿ-i dūstān-i ilāhī bi-ṭirāz-i ḥikmat muzayyan shavand va az har yak ẓāhir shavad ānchi mushʿir va mudill bar irtifāʿ-i amr ast. Ḥaqq ʿulamā-yi ʿaṣr rā inṣāf ʿaṭā farmāyad va baṣar ʿināyat namāyad shāyad anvār-i āftāb-i ḥaqīqat rā ki dar quṭb-i zavāl munīr va rawshan ast mushāhada namāyand va az ū maḥrūm namānand. Lā-zāl īn nufūs sabab-i ḍalālat va gumrāhī būdi va hastand illā man shāʾa Allāh. Yasʾalu al-khādimu rabbahu bi-an yuʿarrifahum wa-yuʿallimahum mā ghafalū ʿanhu wa-yuqarribahum ilayhi faḍlan min ʿindihi. Innahu la-huwa al-ghafūru al-raḥīm.
:::

::: {.translation}
God willing, may all the friends of God be adorned with wisdom, and may each manifest what indicates and attests to the exaltation of the Cause. May God grant the learned men of this age fairness and bestow sight upon them, so that they may behold the rays of the Sun of Truth, shining brightly at its zenith, and not remain deprived of it. These souls have always been, and remain, a cause of error and misguidance, except those whom God wills. This servant asks his Lord to grant them understanding, teach them what they have overlooked, and draw them near to Him as a grace from Himself. He is indeed the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful.
:::

### 131

::: {.original lang="fa"}
عرض دیگر اینکه در بارهٴ مرفوع مرحوم حضرت والد الّذی فاز باللّقآء حین الارتقآء مرقوم \[داشتید\] در ایّامیکه جناب ابوالحسن علیه ٩ ٦٦ \[بهآء اللّه\] در ارض اقدس حضور داشتند یومی از ایّام این عبد و ایشان هر دو در ساحت اقدس تلقاء وجه حاضر بغتةً لسان مقصود عالمیان متکلّم و یک لوح امنع اقدس در ذکر ایشان نازل بجناب مذکور داده شد که برسانند آن محبوب در بارهٴ حضرت مرفوع علیه من کلّ بهآء ابهاه مطمئن باشند
:::

::: {.transliteration}
ʿArḍ-i dīgar īnki dar bāra-yi marfūʿ-i marḥūm ḥaḍrat-i vālid alladhī fāza bi-l-liqāʾi ḥīna al-irtiqāʾ marqūm \[dāshtīd\]. Dar ayyāmīki janāb-i Abu’l-Ḥasan ʿalayhi 9 66 \[Bahāʾ Allāh\] dar arḍ-i aqdas ḥuḍūr dāshtand yawmī az ayyām īn ʿabd va īshān har du dar sāḥat-i aqdas tilqāʾ-i vajh ḥāḍir, baghtatan lisān-i Maqṣūd-i ʿālamiyān mutakallim va yak lawḥ-i amnaʿ-i aqdas dar dhikr-i īshān nāzil, bi-janāb-i madhkūr dādi shud ki birasānand. Ān maḥbūb dar bāra-yi ḥaḍrat-i marfūʿ ʿalayhi min kulli bahāʾin abhāhu muṭmaʾinn bāshand.
:::

::: {.translation}
Another matter: you \[wrote\] concerning your exalted, departed father, who attained the divine presence at the time of his ascension. During the days when Abū’l-Ḥasan, upon him be 9 66 \[the glory of God\], was in the Holy Land, one day he and this servant were both in the Most Holy Presence, before His face. Suddenly the tongue of the Desire of all the worlds spoke, and a most exalted and most holy Tablet was revealed in your father’s remembrance and given to the aforementioned gentleman to deliver. May you, dear friend, be assured concerning your exalted father—upon him be the most glorious of all glory.
:::

### 132

::: {.original lang="fa"}
در مواقع متعدّده ذکر ایشان نازل شده علی شأن تطیر به افئدة العارفین مخصوص در چند مقام خدمات ایشان و استقامت ایشان در امر اللّه از لسان محبوب عالمیان شنیده شد قد ذکره بما لا یأخذه الفنآء و یذکره بما یتوجّه الیه الأفئدة و القلوب
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Dar mavāqiʿ-i mutaʿaddida dhikr-i īshān nāzil shudi ʿalā shaʾnin taṭīru bihi afʾidatu al-ʿārifīn. Makhṣūṣ dar chand maqām khadamāt-i īshān va istiqāmat-i īshān dar Amr-i Allāh az lisān-i Maḥbūb-i ʿālamiyān shinīdi shud. Qad dhakarahu bi-mā lā yaʾkhudhuhu al-fanāʾu wa-yadhkuruhu bi-mā yatawajjahu ilayhi al-afʾidatu wa-l-qulūb.
:::

::: {.translation}
On numerous occasions, words in his remembrance have been revealed in such a manner that the hearts of those who know soar through them. In particular, on several occasions the Beloved of all the worlds was heard speaking of his services and his steadfastness in the Cause of God. He has remembered him in words that will never perish, and will remember him in words toward which hearts and souls will turn.
:::

### 133

::: {.original lang="ar"}
این فانی در آخر کتاب اینقدر عرض مینماید بعنایت محبوب فائزید و هذه بشارة منّی الیکم
:::

::: {.transliteration}
Īn fānī dar ākhir-i kitāb īnqadr ʿarḍ mīnamāyad: bi-ʿināyat-i Maḥbūb fāʾizīd wa-hādhihi bishāratun minnī ilaykum.
:::

::: {.translation}
At the close of this letter, this mortal offers just this: you have attained the loving care of the Beloved, and this is glad tidings from me to you.
:::
